traits.name: Fed by Darkness
traits.description: A voidling in magical darkness at the start of its turn heals 5 hit points.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the voidling's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, spell attack bonus +7). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

at will: darkness, detect magic, fear

3/day each: eldritch blast (3 beams), black tentacles

1/day each: phantasmal force, reverse gravity

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The voidling has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects except those that cause radiant damage.

traits.name: Natural Invisibility
traits.description: A voidling in complete darkness is considered invisible to creatures that rely on normal vision or darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The voidling makes 4 tendril attacks.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Burst
actions.description: The voidling releases a burst of necrotic energy in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on itself. Those in the area take 35 (10d6) necrotic damage, or half damage with a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Darkness Regeneration
traits.description: While in an area of dim light or darkness, the voidling regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The voidling has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Void Traveler
traits.description: The voidling doesn’t require air, food, drink, sleep, or ambient pressure.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The voidling makes four Shadow Tendril or Necrotic Bolt attacks. If two Necrotic Bolt attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Shadow's Grasp
actions.description: The voidling releases a wave of small, grasping tendrils of shadow. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 49 (14d6) necrotic damage and is restrained by tendrils of shadow for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob2:voidpool.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The voidpool can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: The voidpool has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Planar Portal
traits.description: The voidpool has a portal to the Void at its core. A creature that starts its turn grappled by the voidpool must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a success, the creature takes 7 (2d6) force damage but isn’t pulled toward the portal. On a failure, the creature takes no damage but is pulled closer to the portal. A creature that fails three saving throws before escaping the grapple enters the portal and is transported to the Void. This transportation works like the banishing an unwilling creature aspect of the plane shift spell.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The voidpool can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The voidpool makes two pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 13) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the voidpool doesn't have two other creatures grappled. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and it risks being pulled into the Void (see the Planar Portal trait).

monster:tob-2023:volguloth.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13
monster:tob-2023:volguloth.damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Glide
traits.description: The volguloth has draping skin that it can expand while falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The volguloth can’t gain height with its expanded skin alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The volguloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Poisoned Weapons
traits.description: The volguloth’s weapons are coated with a magical poison. When the volguloth hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 poison damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The volguloth makes two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 13), and the volguloth uses its Enshroud on the target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Enshroud
actions.description: The volguloth enshrouds a Medium or smaller target grappled by it. The enshrouded target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe or speak until the grapple ends. If the volguloth moves, the enshrouded target moves with it. The volguloth can have only one creature enshrouded at a time, and it can't use its Glide trait while enshrouding a creature.

bonusActions.name: Strangle
bonusActions.description: A creature enshrouded by the volguloth must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and begin suffocating, as the air is squeezed from its lungs.

monster:tob3:vorthropod.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Lava Bound
traits.description: Can exist outside of lava or magma for up to 4 hrs each day. If it starts its turn outside of lava and didn’t take fire since end of its previous turn its shell begins to cool and harden. While its shell is hardened has walking speed of 20' AC 18 and vulnerability to bludgeoning. If it starts its turn in lava or if it took fire damage since end of its previous turn its shell becomes molten again. If vorthropod remains outside of lava for more than 4 hrs its shell becomes petrified transforming into basalt and vorthropod within goes into hibernation. Its body returns to normal if it is submerged in lava or magma for 1 round. It can stay petrified in hibernation for up to 1d100+10 years after which it dies.

traits.name: Lava Camouflage
traits.description: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in lava and volcanic terrain.

traits.name: Molten Shell
traits.description: If Its shell isn’t hardened creature that touches it or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) fire.

monster:a5e-mm:vrock.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.
monster:a5e-mm:vrock.damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning; damage from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Chaotic Evil
traits.description: The vrock radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vrock has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vrock attacks with its beak and its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the vrock has advantage on the attack roll  it deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spores
actions.description: A 15-foot-radius cloud of spores emanates from the vrock  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw  becoming poisoned for 1 minute on a failure. While poisoned in this way  the target takes ongoing 5 (1d10) poison damage. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Stunning Screech
bonusActions.description: The vrock screeches. Each non-demon creature within 20 feet that can hear it makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of the vrocks next turn.

monster:bfrd:vrock.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 20 ft.
monster:bfrd:vrock.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, Demonic Resilience

traits.name: Demonic Resilience
traits.description: The vrock is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vrock has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vrock makes one Beak attack and two Talon attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Wing Spores
actions.description: The vrock shakes a cloud of toxic spores from its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 15 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (8d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. While poisoned, a creature takes 3 (1d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Emptying a vial of holy water on the poisoned creature also ends the effect on it.

bonusActions.name: Startling Screech
bonusActions.description: The vrock emits a horrific screech at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or be able to take either an action or bonus action on its turn, not both, and it can't take reactions.

monster:a5e-mm:vulture.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The vulture has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight and smell.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Retreat
reactions.description: When the vulture would be hit by a melee attack, the vulture can move 5 feet away from the attacker. If this moves the vulture out of the attackers reach, the attacker has disadvantage on its attack.

monster:bfrd:vulture.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Carrion Sense
traits.description: The vulture can pinpoint, by scent, the location of carrion, dead creatures, and Undead without the Incorporeal Movement trait within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Heightened Sight and Smell
traits.description: The vulture's Perception is 18 when perceiving by sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The vulture has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Defensive Bile
reactions.description: When a creature the vulture can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the vulture can spit partially digested carrion at the creature. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 CON save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

monster:bfrd:vulture-giant.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 5 ft.

traits.name: Carrion Sense
traits.description: The vulture can pinpoint, by scent, the location of carrion, dead creatures, and Undead without the Incorporeal Movement trait within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Heightened Sight and Smell
traits.description: The vulture's Perception is 18 when perceiving by sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The vulture has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vulture makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Defensive Bile
reactions.description: When a creature the vulture can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the vulture can spit partially digested carrion at the creature. The attacker must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or take 5 (2d4) acid damage and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

monster:tob-2023:v-ttir.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 30 ft., passive Perception 11
monster:tob-2023:v-ttir.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Grave Goods Sense
traits.description: The vættir can pinpoint the location of creatures wearing or carrying one of the vættir’s personal items or grave goods within 60 feet of it, and the vættir can sense the general direction of its personal items and grave goods within 1 mile of it.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: A destroyed vættir gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body forms in a random unoccupied space within 100 feet of where it fell. This trait doesn’t function if the vættir is put to rest (typically by returning its remains to its burial mound).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the vættir has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: The vættir doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The væ00e6ttir can use its Disorienting Gaze. It then makes two Væ00e6ttir's Greataxe or Necrotic Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Væ00e6ttir's Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Disorienting Gaze
actions.description: The væ00e6ttir locks eyes with one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute. While incapacitated, the creature moves in a random direction when it moves. An incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the væ00e6ttir's Disorienting Gaze for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Corpse Breath
actions.description: The væ00e6ttir spews forth a 15-foot cone of putrid gas. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob3:wakwak.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 10 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty Pounce
traits.description: If the wakwak moves at least 20' straight toward a creature and then hits it with Talon attack on the same turn that target must make DC 13 Str save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone the wakwak can make one Beak attack vs. it as a bonus action gaining temp hp equal to half the damage dealt.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

monster:a5e-mm:walking-statue.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Bludgeoning Weakness
traits.description: When the statue takes more than 10 bludgeoning damage from one attack, it falls prone.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless, the statue is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

traits.name: Spell-created
traits.description: The DC for Dispel Magic to destroy this creature is 19.

actions.name: Smash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monster:tob2:walled-horror.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
monster:tob2:walled-horror.damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:walled-horror.conditionImmunities: blinded, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Spirit-infused Structure
traits.description: The walled horror is immobile except for its Wall Hop trait. It uses its Charisma instead of its Dexterity to determine its place in the initiative order.

traits.name: Wall-bound Spirits
traits.description: The spirits that make up the walled horror are bound to a 10-foot-by-10-foot panel of wall, behind which their original bodies are trapped. The walled horror can move to nearby walls with its Wall Hop trait, but it can never be more than 120 feet away from its bound wall. If its bound wall is damaged while the walled horror is elsewhere, the walled horror takes half the damage dealt to the bound wall. When the walled horror finishes a long rest while inhabiting its bound wall, any damage to the bound wall is repaired.

traits.name: Wall Hop
traits.description: As a bonus action, the walled horror can disappear into the wall and reappear on a 10-foot-by-10-foot stone wall or panel of wood that it can see within 30 feet of it. Claw marks briefly appear on the surface of the origin and destination walls when it uses this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The walled horror makes two spectral claw attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Spectral Scream
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it is assaulted by images of being buried alive or entombed. While frightened, the creature's speed is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Entomb
actions.description:
The walled horror makes one spectral claw attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the creature is partially entombed in the wall, and the grapple ends. The entombed target is blinded and restrained, and it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage at the start of each of the walled horror's turns. A walled horror can have only one creature entombed at a time.

A creature, including the entombed target, can take its action to free the entombed target by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check.

A creature slain while entombed is pulled fully into the wall and can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a wish spell.

traits.name: Luring Scent
traits.description: When a beast, humanoid or fey creature begins its turn within 30 feet, the creature makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it moves as close as it can to the wallflower and ends its turn. Creatures immune to being charmed are immune to this effect. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Luring Scent of all wallflowers for 24 hours.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends  the grick can't attack a different target with its tentacles.

bonusActions.name: Beak
bonusActions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the grick. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Focused Animosity
traits.description: The wampus cat has advantage on melee attacks against any male she has seen employ divine magic or wield a holy symbol.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
the wampus cat's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

at will: disguise self (appearance of a female human), mage hand

2/day: hex

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The wampus cat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Yowl
actions.description: Intelligent creatures within 60 feet of the cat who are able to hear its voice must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. Those who fail find the sound of the wampus cat's voice pleasant and alluring, so that the cat has advantage on Charisma checks against them for 1 minute. The affected characters cannot attack the wampus cat during this time unless they are wounded in that time.

traits.name: Divine Animosity
traits.description: The wampus cat has advantage on attack rolls against creatures wielding divine or celestial power, such as clerics, paladins, or aasimars.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sweet Song
actions.description: The wampus cat sings a sweet melody. Each creature within 60 feet of her that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the wampus cat's Sweet Song for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Terrifying Yowl
actions.description: The wampus cat emits an ear-piercing yowl. Each creature within 15 feet of the wampus cat that can hear the yowl must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) thunder damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The wampus cat magically polymorphs into a Medium female Humanoid, or back into her true form. Her statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

monster:tob3:wandering-haze.speed: 5 ft., Climb 2 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 2 ft.
monster:tob3:wandering-haze.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Acidic Fog
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in the wandering haze’s space takes 7 (2d6) acid.

traits.name: Cloud Form
traits.description: Can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide with o squeezing and can enter a hostile creature’s space and vice versa. The haze’s space is heavily obscured.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary cloud or fog bank.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require sleep.

monster:tob2:wanyudo.damageResistances: cold, lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Burn the Righteous
traits.description: The wanyudo has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the creature is wearing a holy symbol or calls on the power of a divine entity to cast spells.

traits.name: Fiery Charge
traits.description: If the wanyudo moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The wanyudo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The wanyudo has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wanyudo makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Flaming Breath
actions.description: The wanyudo exhales fire in a 20-foot cone from one of its heads. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the war horse skeleton remains motionless and prone, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate war horse skeleton.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: The skeleton doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Undead Resilience
traits.description: The skeleton is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Counterattack
bonusActions.description: When a creature the war horse skeleton can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the skeleton can make one Hooves attack against the attacker.

monster:ccdx:war-machine-golem.damageImmunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine
monster:ccdx:war-machine-golem.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The golem deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two slam attacks and one catapult attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Catapult
actions.description: The war machine golem hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The war machine golem breathes fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Leaping Pounce
traits.description: If the war ostrich jumps at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the ostrich can make one Beak attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The war ostrich’s long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Intimidating Screech
actions.description: The war ostrich screeches at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, as the screech rattles it.

bonusActions.name: Skittish
bonusActions.description: The war ostrich takes the Dash or Disengage action.

monster:ccdx:war-wyvern.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 10 ft.
monster:ccdx:war-wyvern.languages: understands Common and Draconic, but can't speak

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The wyvern deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wyvern makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger. While flying, it can use its claws in place of one other attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage and the creature is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the wyvern can't use its claw on another target.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spit Venom
actions.description: The wyvern spits venom at a target within 60 feet. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob2:wardu.languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The wardu doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The wardu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wardu uses its Segmented Gaze. It then makes two proboscis attacks.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the wardu regains hp equal to half the damage dealt. If the target is a spellcaster, the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain its concentration until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Segmented Gaze
actions.description: The wardu's segmented central eye flares with unstable magical energy. One creature the wardu can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer a random condition until the end of its next turn. Roll a d4 to determine the condition: blinded (1), frightened (2), deafened (3), or incapacitated (4).

traits.name: Aggressive Charge
traits.description: The eye moves up to their Speed towards an enemy they can see or hear.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The priest is a 5th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13 +5to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): Guidance, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy
- 1st-Level (4 slots): Ceremony, Detect Evil and Good, Guiding Bolt, Bless
- 2nd-Level (3 slots): Lesser Restoration, Arcane Eye
- 3rd-Level (2 slots): Dispel Magic, Spirit Guardians

traits.name: Warhordling Orc Eye Spellcasting
traits.description: The eye has advantage on attack rolls made against targets they can see with Arcane Eye.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. On a hit  the priest can expend a spell slot to deal 7 (2d6) radiant damage  plus an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage for each level of the spell slot expended above 1st.

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.description: (Cantrip; V, S) One creature the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw  taking 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

actions.name: Guiding Bolt
actions.description: (1st-Level; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) radiant damage  and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of the priests next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Dispel Magic
actions.description: (3rd-Level; V, S) The priest scours the magic from one creature  object  or magical effect within 120 feet that they can see. A spell ends if it was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot. For spells using a 4th-level or higher spell slot  the priest makes a Wisdom ability check (DC 10 + the spells level) for each one  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Spirit Guardians
actions.description: (3rd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) Spectral forms surround the priest in a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes. The priest can choose creatures they can see to be unaffected by the spell. Other creatures treat the area as difficult terrain  and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there  it makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) radiant or necrotic damage (priests choice) on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Healing Word
bonusActions.description: (1st-Level; V) The priest or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The priest can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warrior attacks twice.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage. If the warrior has moved this turn  this attack is made with advantage.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive Charge
bonusActions.description: The war chief moves up to their Speed towards an enemy they can see or hear.

bonusActions.name: Whirling Axe
bonusActions.description: The war chief attacks with their greataxe.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d12 + 1) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive Charge
bonusActions.description: The warrior moves up to their Speed towards an enemy they can see or hear.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) bludgeoning damage. If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

monster:ccdx:warlock-s-trumpetbloom.languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.description: A creature who attempts to communicate with the trumpetbloom must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The trumpetbloom has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The trumpetbloom makes three attacks: one with its stinger and two with its tendrils.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The target is paralyzed while poisoned in this way. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The trumpetbloom has two tendrils, each of which can grapple only one target.

monster:a5e-mm:warlords-ghost.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:a5e-mm:warlords-ghost.languages: the languages it spoke in life
monster:a5e-mm:warlords-ghost.damageResistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; damage from nonmagical weapons
monster:a5e-mm:warlords-ghost.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Death Howl
traits.description: When reduced to 0 hit points, the banshee uses Baleful Wail.

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.description: The banshee magically senses the general direction of living creatures up to 5 miles away.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The banshee can move through creatures and objects. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: A banshee doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

traits.name: Unquiet Spirit
traits.description: If defeated in combat, the banshee returns on the anniversary of its death. It can be permanently put to rest only by finding and casting Remove Curse on its grave or by righting whatever wrong was done to it.

actions.name: Presage Death
actions.description: The banshee targets a creature within 60 feet that can hear it  predicting its doom. The target makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 11 (2d6 + 4) psychic damage and is magically cursed for 1 hour. While cursed in this way  the target has disadvantage on saving throws against the banshees Baleful Wail.

actions.name: Baleful Wail
actions.description: The banshee shrieks. All living creatures within 30 feet of it that can hear it make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  a creature takes 11 (2d6 + 4) psychic damage. If the creature is cursed by the banshee  it drops to 0 hit points instead.

reactions.name: Wounded Warning
reactions.description: When the banshee takes damage from a creature within 60 feet, it uses Presage Death on the attacker.

monster:tob2:warmth-thief.speed: 10 ft., Climb 5 ft., Fly 40 ft. (hover), Swim 5 ft.
monster:tob2:warmth-thief.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

traits.name: Aura of Warmth Stealing
traits.description: At the start of each of the warmth thief’s turns, each creature within 5 feet of the warmth thief must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) cold damage. The warmth thief regains hp equal to the single highest amount of cold damage dealt.

traits.name: Cold Physiology
traits.description: A warmth thief can’t abide constant warmth. Each hour it spends in an area with a temperature above 40 degrees Fahrenheit, the warmth thief must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion that can’t be removed until it finishes a long rest in an area with a temperature below 40 degrees.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warmth thief makes two freezing claw attacks.

actions.name: Freezing Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage. The warmth thief regains hp equal to half the cold damage dealt. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be chilled for 1 minute. A chilled creature takes 7 (2d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. A chilled creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A humanoid slain while chilled rises 24 hours later as a chill haunt, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Area Vulnerability
traits.description: The band takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

traits.name: Band
traits.description: The band is composed of 5 or more warriors. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects. The band can move through any opening large enough for one Medium creature without squeezing.

traits.name: Band Dispersal
traits.description: When the band is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 2 (1d4) warriors with 5 hit points each.

actions.name: Spears
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d6 + 5) piercing damage  or half damage when bloodied.

monster:ccdx:wasteland-dragon-wyrmling.speed: 30 ft., Burrow 15 ft., Climb 30 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:ccdx:wasteland-dragon-wyrmling.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Warped Energy Breath
actions.description: The dragon blasts warped arcane energy in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:a5e-mm:water-elemental.conditionImmunities: fatigue, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Conductive
traits.description: If the elemental takes lightning damage, each creature sharing its space takes the same amount of lightning damage.

traits.name: Fluid Form
traits.description: The elemental can enter and end its turn in other creatures spaces and move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.description: If the elemental takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 15 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Whelm
actions.description: The elemental targets each Large or smaller creature in its space. Each target makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained and unable to breathe air. The elemental can move at full speed while carrying grappled creatures inside its space. It can grapple one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures.

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.description: The elemental doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Elemental Resilience
traits.description: The elemental is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, and unconscious conditions.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.description: If the elemental takes cold damage, it partially freezes, and its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Purify Water
traits.description: If the water elemental sits in a body of slow-flowing or standing water, such as a spring, small creek, or lake, for at least 1 hour, the water becomes purified and rendered free of poison and disease. In slow-flowing water, this purification fades 1 hour after the elemental leaves the water. In standing water, this purification lasts until a contaminant enters the water while the elemental isn't in it.

traits.name: Water Camouflage
traits.description: The water elemental's Stealth is 17 while in a Medium or larger body of water.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The water elemental makes two Water Tendril or Water Bolt attacks. If both Water Tendril attacks hit one creature, it can use Whelm on the target, if available.

actions.name: Water Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is Large or smaller. The water elemental can have up to three targets grappled at a time.

actions.name: Water Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Whelm
actions.description: The water elemental envelops one creature it is grappling, and the grapple ends. While enveloped, the target is restrained, unable to breathe unless it can breathe water, can't be hit by the elemental's Water Tendril, and it takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the elemental's turns.When the elemental moves, the enveloped creature moves with it. The elemental can have only one creature enveloped at a time. A creature within 5 feet of the elemental, including the target, can take its action to free the target from the elemental by succeeding on a DC 15 STR check.

bonusActions.name: Purify Blood
bonusActions.description: The water elemental touches a willing creature that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target is cured of the poisoned condition and of any disease afflicting it.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The water horse can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The water horse can use its action to polymorph into a Medium humanoid, a horse, or its true horse-humanoid hybrid form. Its statistics, other than its size, speed, and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The water horse can use its Charming Gaze. In horse form, it then makes two bite attacks. In humanoid form, it then makes two longsword attacks. In hybrid form, it then makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its longsword.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Charming Gaze
actions.description: The water horse targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, the target is incapacitated and can only move toward the water horse. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The target has advantage on the saving throw if it has taken damage since the end of its last turn. If the target successfully saves or if the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this water horse's Charming Gaze for the next 24 hours.

monster:tob:water-leaper.speed: 5 ft., Climb 2 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 40 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The water leaper can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: The water leaper has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The water leaper uses its shriek and makes one bite attack and one stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the water leaper can't bite another target.

actions.name: Shriek
actions.description: The water leaper lets out a blood-curdling shriek. Every creature within 40 feet that can hear the water leaper must make a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be frightened until the start of the water leaper's next turn. A creature that successfully saves against the shriek is immune to the effect for 24 hours.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target must make a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of its turn. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The water leaper makes a bite attack against a medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the water leaper. A swallowed target takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of the water leaper's turn. The water leaper can have one creature swallowed at a time. If the water leaper dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can use 5 feet of movement to crawl, prone, out of the corpse.

monster:tob-2023:water-leaper.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 5 ft., Swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The water leaper can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.description: The water leaper has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The water leaper makes one Bite attack and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the water leaper can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature takes 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The water leaper makes a Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the water leaper, and it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the water leaper's turns. The water leaper can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

monster:tob3:waterkledde.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 40 ft.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 15 min.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: Magically transforms into a Small or Med Beast or back into its true fiendish form. Without wings it loses its flying speed. Its statistics other than its size and speed are the same in each form. No matter the form its eyes are always an unnatural green. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Reverts on death.

bonusActions.name: Supernatural Speed
bonusActions.description: Takes Dash or Disengage.

traits.name: Fishform
traits.description: As a bonus action, the waverider can transform into a hunter shark or giant octopus. While in this form, the waverider cannot cast spells, but can expend a spell slot as a bonus action to regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended. When the waverider is reduced to 0 hit points, falls unconscious, or dies in this form, it reverts to its humanoid form. It can remain in fishform for up to 3 hours, and can enter fishform twice, regaining expended uses after completing a short or long rest.

traits.name: Healing Tides
traits.description: Whenever the waverider casts a spell of 1st level or higher that affects a nonhostile creature, that creature regains 3 hit points (in addition to any healing the spell may provide).

traits.name: Marine Empathy
traits.description: The waverider can speak with and understand aquatic plants and animals.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The waverider is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, poison spray, resistance
- 1st Level (4 slots): cure wounds, create or destroy water, healing word
- 2nd Level (3 slots): animal messenger, enhance ability, lesser restoration
- 3rd Level (3 slots): conjure animals (aquatic beasts only), water walk, water breathing
- 4th Level (1 slots): control water

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Attacks with this weapon while underwater are not made with disadvantage.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The weasel has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing and smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage. If this damage would reduce a Small or larger target to 0 hit points  the target takes no damage from this attack.

traits.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The weasel's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the weasel can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying, provided the item weighs no more than 5 pounds, can fit in one hand, isn't a weapon, and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target. For example, a weasel could steal a hat or belt pouch but not a creature's shirt or armor.

traits.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The weasel's Perception is 18 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the weasel can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying, provided the item weighs no more than 10 pounds, isn't a weapon, and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target. For example, a weasel could steal a hat or belt pouch but not a creature's shirt or armor.

reactions.name: Repellent Spray
reactions.description: When a creature the weasel can see moves to a space within 15 feet of it, the weasel can release a pungent spray at the creature. The target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned, the creature can't move to a space within 5 feet of the weasel.

monster:tob:weaving-spider.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The weaving spider is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The weaving spider has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The weaving spider makes two trimming blade attacks or two needle shuttle attacks.

actions.name: Trimming Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage and possible unmaking.

actions.name: Poisoned Needle Shuttle
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.

actions.name: Unmaking
actions.description: The weaving spider's speed and its slim, sharp blade can slice cloth, leather, and paper into scraps very quickly. Whenever a weaving spider's trimming blade attack roll exceeds the target's armor class by 5 or more, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or one of their possessions becomes unusable or damaged until repaired (DM's choice)

monster:tob2:web-zombie.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Necrotic Weapons
traits.description: When the web zombie hits a creature with a melee attack, the attack deals an extra 1d6 necrotic damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The web zombie can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The web zombie ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The web zombie makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 11 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Acidic Tears
traits.description: Thick tears of dark sap stream continuously down the treant's face and trunk. These tears are highly acidic - anyone who attacks the treant from a range of 5 feet or less must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 6 (1d12) acid damage from splashed tears. This acidic matter continues doing 6 (1d12) acid damage at the start of each of the creature's turns until it or an adjacent ally uses an action to wipe off the tears or three rounds elapse.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Treespeech
traits.description: A weeping treant can converse with plants, and most plants greet them with a friendly or helpful attitude.
