monster:tob3:wraith-oathrot.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Aura of Oathbreaking
traits.description: Any creature that begins its turn within 30' of wraith: DC 13 Cha save or become cursed losing its resolve in important oaths it has taken. While cursed creature has disadvantage on Con saves to maintain concentration and can’t add its proficiency bonus to ability checks and saves in which it is proficient. On success creature is immune to wraith’s Aura of Oathbreaking for 24 hrs.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Move through others/objects as difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends turn in object.

traits.name: Oathseeker
traits.description: Can pinpoint the location of any cleric paladin celestial or other divine connected creature within 60' of it.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

traits.name: Intuition
traits.description: The wyrdling rolls two dice for initiative, taking the higher number. In addition, the wyrdling has advantage on WIS (Insight) checks.

traits.name: Read Fate
traits.description: The wyrdling can spend 1 minute communing with fate on behalf of one creature that remains within 10 feet of it for the duration. The creature must ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. At the end of the minute, the wyrdling pronounces the result of the target's inquiry. This trait works like the divination spell, except it can't be used to answer a specific creature's question more than once every 3 days, regardless if the creature asks a different question.

actions.name: Psychic Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6+3) psychic damage.

bonusActions.name: Pronounce Fate
bonusActions.description: The wyrdling pronounces the fate, either fortune or doom (the wyrdling's choice), of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target rolls a d4 and adds (fortune) or subtracts (doom) the number rolled to the next attack roll or save it makes before the start of the wyrdling's next turn.

reactions.name: Call on Fate
reactions.description: When the wyrdling is attacked by a creature it can see, it can pluck the strands of fate around the creature, imposing disadvantage on that attack roll. If the attack misses, the wyrdling or one friendly creature it can see within 30 feet of it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the attacker before the end of the wyrdling's next turn.

monster:tob:wyrmling-wind-dragon.speed: 40 ft., Climb 20 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 20 ft.
monster:tob:wyrmling-wind-dragon.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath of Gales
actions.description: The dragon exhales a blast of wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that cone must make a successful DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from the dragon and knocked prone. Unprotected flames in the cone are extinguished, and sheltered flames (such as those in lanterns) have a 50 percent chance of being extinguished.

monster:a5e-mm:wyvern.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 10 ft.

traits.name: Imperfect Flight
traits.description: While bloodied, the wyverns fly speed is halved, and it can't gain altitude.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wyvern attacks once with its bite and once with its stinger. While flying  it can use its claws in place of one other attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage. If the wyvern is attacking from above  the target is grappled by the wyvern (escape DC 15). While grappling a target in this way  the wyverns Speed is reduced to 0  it can't use its claws to attack any other creature  and it has advantage on attacks against the target.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw  taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

monster:bfrd:wyvern.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 10 ft.

traits.name: Clumsy
traits.description: While not flying, the wyvern is vulnerable to the grappled, prone, and restrained conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wyvern makes one Bite attack and one Stinger attack. While flying, it can replace one attack with a Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Reflexive Tail Whip
reactions.description: When a creature moves into a space within 15 feet of the wyvern, it can whip its tail at the creature. The target must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: The wyvern knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Ring of Feather Falling
traits.description: When the wyvern knight falls while wearing this ring, it descends 60 feet per round and takes no damage from falling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wyvern knight makes two lance attacks. If the wyvern knight is riding a war wyvern, its mount can then make one bite, claw, or stinger attack.

actions.name: Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The wyvern knight has disadvantage on attacks with this weapon against creatures within 5 feet of it and can wield this weapon in one hand instead of two while mounted.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

reactions.name: Protection
reactions.description: When a creature the wyvern knight can see attacks a target that is within 5 feet of it, including a creature it is riding, the knight can use a reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. The knight must be wielding a shield.

monster:tob:xanka.languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.description: A xanka doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Ingest Weapons
traits.description: When the xanka is hit by a melee weapon and the final, adjusted attack roll is 19 or less, the weapon gains a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls, after inflicting damage for this attack. If the penalty reaches -5, the weapon is destroyed. Even magic weapons are subject to this effect.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The xanka's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Absorb
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) force damage, and the xanka regains hit points equal to the damage caused by its attack. In addition, a living creature hit by this attack must make a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or suffer a gaping wound that causes 2 (1d4) necrotic damage at the end of each of the creature's turns until the wound is treated with magical healing or with a successful DC 10 Intelligence (Medicine) check. If a creature who fails this saving throw is wearing armor or using a shield, the creature can choose to prevent the necrotic damage by permanently reducing the AC of its armor or shield by 1 instead.

monster:tob-2023:xanka.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob-2023:xanka.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Absorb
traits.description: Any nonmagical object that touches the xanka’s central globe, any nonmagical weapon that hits the xanka, or any nonmagical object, structure, or creature hit by the xanka’s Dismantling Leg attack begins to deteriorate. If it is a structure or an object that isn’t being worn or carried, up to a 1-foot cube of the structure or object is destroyed. If it is an object worn or carried by a creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the item being affected by the xanka’s Absorb.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: The xanka doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Dismantling Leg
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is subjected to the xanka's Absorb trait.

actions.name: Release Energy
actions.description: The xanka releases energy created from absorbed material in a burst. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster:tob3:xecha.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Can move through a space as narrow as 1' wide with o squeezing. Any equipment worn/carried is left behind when it goes through a space too small for the equipment.

traits.name: Assume the Dead
traits.description: Enters corpse of a Small Medium or Large creature that has been dead less than 24 hrs impersonating it for 2d4 days before body decays. If xecha takes 15 damage or more on a single turn while inhabiting body it must make DC 15 Con save or be ejected from the body which falls apart and is destroyed. Its stats except size are same in each body.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.description: Even when in plain sight it takes a successful DC 16 Wis (Perception) check to spot a xecha that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the xecha’s space while unaware of it is surprised by the xecha.

traits.name: Disguise
traits.description: The xenabsorber has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks to pass itself off as the type of creature it is impersonating as long as it has at least 1 trait from that creature.

traits.name: Trait Mimicry
traits.description: As a bonus action, a xenabsorber can take on 1 nonmagical physical trait, attack, or reaction of a beast or humanoid with a challenge rating equal to or less than its own that it has seen within the last week (see Trait Mimicry sidebar). It can have up to 5 such traits at a time, no more than two of which can be attacks. Each trait lasts until the xenabsorber replaces it with another trait as a bonus action. If the xenabsorber goes a week without exposure to a single beast or humanoid, it loses all of its traits and reverts back to its true, blue crystalline form.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xenabsorber makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monster:tob:xhkarsh.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 16

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xhkarsh makes two claw attacks and two stinger attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have its fate corrupted. A creature with corrupted fate has disadvantage on Charisma checks and Charisma saving throws, and it is immune to divination spells and to effects that sense emotions or read thoughts. The target's fate can be restored by a dispel evil and good spell or comparable magic.

actions.name: Seize Strand
actions.description: The xhkarsh targets one creature within 5 feet of it whose fate has been corrupted. The target creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or a portion of the xhkarsh's consciousness inhabits its body. The target retains control of its body, but the xhkarsh can control its actions for 1 minute each day and can modify its memories as a bonus action (as if using the modify memory spell, DC 15). The target is unaware of the xhkarsh's presence, but can make a DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check once every 24 hours to notice the presence of the xhkarsh. This effect lasts until the xhkarsh ends it or the target's fate is restored by a dispel evil and good spell or comparable magic. A creature becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours when it succeeds on the saving throw to resist the effect or after the effect ends on it for any reason. A single xhkarsh can seize up to four strands at the same time.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The xhkarsh turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends. Equipment the xhkarsh wears or carries becomes invisible with it.

monster:tob-2023:xhkarsh.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 17
monster:tob-2023:xhkarsh.languages: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Corruption’s Bond
traits.description: The xhkarsh ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature whose fate it has corrupted. In addition, it can pinpoint the location of any such creature, as well as sense the creature’s general state of health. These effects function even if the xhkarsh and the creature are on different planes of existence.

traits.name: Interdimensional Nature
traits.description: The xhkarsh doesn’t require air, food, drink, sleep, or ambient pressure.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xhkarsh makes two Claw attacks and one Fate-Altering Stinger attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Fate-Altering Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or have its fate corrupted. A creature with corrupted fate has disadvantage on Charisma checks and Charisma saving throws, can't be targeted by any divination magic, can't be perceived through magical scrying sensors, and is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts. The target's fate can be restored, ending the corruption and breaking the xhkarsh's magical tie to the target, by a dispel evil and good spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The xhkarsh magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Seize Strand, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the xhkarsh wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Seize Strand
actions.description: One creature whose fate is corrupted by this xhkarsh must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be affected by the geas spell for 8 hours. While under the geas, the affected creature must perform a specific, seemingly minor task that furthers the decades-long goals of the xhkarsh. Such a task could be writing a letter to a specific person, damaging a seemingly random piece of equipment, or speaking a specific sentence to a particular person. The xhkarsh can use Seize Strand on a particular creature no more than once every 24 hours, regardless of success or failure on the saving throw.

traits.name: Indomitable
traits.description: Any spell or effect that would make the xing tian paralyzed, restrained, or stunned ends at the end of the xing tian’s next turn, regardless of the spell or effect’s normal duration.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.description: The xing tian has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xing tian makes three attacks: one with its shield slam and two with its battleaxe. If both battleaxe attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take an extra 11 (2d10) piercing damage as the xing tian bites the target.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shield Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Dance of the Unyielding
actions.description: The xing tian stomps and waves its arms in a martial dance, and it regains 10 hp. Until the dance ends, the xing tian regains 10 hp at the start of each of its turns and melee attack rolls against the xing tian have disadvantage. It must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue dancing. It can stop dancing at any time. The dance ends if the xing tian is incapacitated.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the xiphus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the xiphus instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the xiphus is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Siphon Time (Recharge 5-6)
traits.description: As a bonus action, a xiphus chooses one creature it can see. The xiphus' clockwork heart vibrates rapidly, bending time to give the xiphus the upper hand against its chosen target. The xiphus chooses whether to have advantage on its attacks against that target or on saving throws against spells cast by the target until the start of the xiphus' next turn.

traits.name: Startling Speed
traits.description: The movements of a xiphus are so swift that it is almost invisible when in motion. If the xiphus moves at least 10 feet on its turn, attack rolls against it have disadvantage until the start of its next turn unless the xiphus is incapacitated or restrained.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xiphus makes three hidden dagger attacks.

actions.name: Hidden Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

reactions.name: Borrowed Time
reactions.description: If damage is dealt to a xiphus that would kill it, it can attempt to temporarily borrow time from another creature to avoid death. One creature the xiphus can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the xiphus regains hp equal to the damage taken. The target is stable and doesn't die if this effect reduces its hp to 0. After 2 rounds, the xiphus takes necrotic damage, and the target regains hp, equal to the original amount borrowed.

monster:a5e-mm:xorn.speed: 20 ft., Burrow 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Swim 10 ft.
monster:a5e-mm:xorn.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 16
monster:a5e-mm:xorn.damageResistances: acid; damage from nonmagical, non-adamantine weapons

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: The xorn has advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: The xorn can locate by smell coins and gems within 500 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xorn makes three claw attacks and then makes a bite attack if it can.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that was hit by the xorns claws at least twice this turn. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage  and the xorn consumes one of the following nonmagical objects in the targets possession: a worn set of metal armor or a carried metal weapon or shield  a piece of metal equipment  a gem  or up to 1 000 coins. For 1 minute after an item is consumed  a creature can retrieve it from the gullet of a willing  incapacitated  or dead xorn  taking 7 (2d6) acid damage in the process.

monster:bfrd:xorn.speed: 20 ft., Burrow 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Swim 10 ft.
monster:bfrd:xorn.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10
monster:bfrd:xorn.damageResistances: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn't disturb the material through which it moves.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: The xorn's Stealth is 18 while in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xorn makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks, or it makes three Lob Stone attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Lob Stone
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Shard Belch
bonusActions.description: The xorn belches a mixture of stomach gas and crystalline shards in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 DEX save or be coated in miniscule, crystalline shards until the end of its next turn. A creature coated in shards suffers bouts of pain each time it moves, reducing its speed by 10 feet and imposing disadvantage on all weapon attack rolls.

monster:ccdx:yaga-goo.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The goo can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Deadly to Fey
traits.description: The goo has advantage on attack rolls against fey and any creature with the Fey Ancestry trait.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The goo can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Yaga goo makes two pseudopod attacks. When its Foul Transit is available, it can use Foul Transit in place of one pseudopod attack.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Foul Transit
actions.description: The goo teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 50 feet, leaving behind a wretched puddle in the space it previously occupied. A creature within 5 feet of the space the goo left must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and become poisoned until the end of its next turn. The first time a creature enters the puddle's space or if a creature starts its turn in the puddle's space it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and is poisoned. The puddle lasts for 1 minute or until the goo that created it is killed.

reactions.name: Puddle Splash
reactions.description: When a creature the Yaga goo can see targets it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the goo, the goo can teleport to a puddle created by its Foul Transit, if that puddle's space is unoccupied, negating the damage from the attack. If it does, the attacker must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and become poisoned until the end of its next turn.

monster:ccdx:yakirian.languages: Common, Yakirian, understands Void Speech but won't speak it

traits.name: Resilient Soul
traits.description: The yakirian has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, or confused, as well as against any effect that causes corruption or madness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yakirian makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its ritual knife.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ritual Knife
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Consume Heart
actions.description:
The yakiran consumes the heart of a dead humanoid or giant within 5 feet. If the creature also less than 1 minute ago, the yakirian gains the following benefits:
 The yakirian absorbs the dead creature's knowledge and asks two questions. If the dead creature knew the answers in life, the yakirian learns them instantly.
 The yakirian's maximum and current hp increase by 10 for 1 hour.
 The yakirian has advantage on Strength-based attack rolls and ability checks, as well as on all saving throws for 1 hour.

monster:tob3:yali.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.description: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless indistinguishable from ordinary statue.

traits.name: Flinging Pounce
traits.description: If it moves 20'+straight toward a Large or smaller creature and then hits it with Tusk on same turn target thrown up to 15 ft. in a random direction and knocked prone (DC 12 Str negates throw and prone). If thrown target strikes a solid surface target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. it was thrown. If target is thrown at another creature creature takes same damage and knocked prone (DC 12 Dex negates both).

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Long jump is up to 40' and its high jump is up to 20' with or with o a running start.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The yann-an-oed can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.description: The yann-an-oed has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The yann-an-oed can have only two targets grappled at a time.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The yann-an-oed makes a bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the yann-an-oed, and it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the yann-an-oed's turns. A yannan-oed can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the yann-an-oed takes 10 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the yann-an-oed must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the yann-an-oed. If the yann-an-oed dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Hoot
actions.description: The yann-an-oed emits an owl-like hoot from a blowhole near the top of its head. Each creature within 120 feet that is able to hear the sound must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or return the hooting sound, if it can make noise. The yann-an-oed is able to unerringly track a creature that responds to its call for 1 hour, even if the creature is hidden by magic or on another plane of existence.

monster:tob2:yaojing.damageResistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Charlatan’s Bane
traits.description: The yaojing knows if it hears a lie, and it has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to determine if a creature is attempting to deceive it.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The yaojing’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no verbal or material components.
At will: detect evil and good, silence
3/day each: beacon of hope, bestow curse
1/day each: death ward, dispel evil and good

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The yaojing has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.description: The dragon exhales a blast of stormy wind in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from the dragon and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone. Unprotected flames, such as torches, in the area are extinguished, and protected flames, such as those in lanterns, have a 50 percent chance of being extinguished.

traits.name: Living Projection
traits.description:
The yowler’s undead form is constantly covered with a magical illusion that makes it look like it did in life. This effect is suppressed for 1 minute if the yowler attacks or uses Yowl.

The changes wrought by this illusion fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the yowler’s fur appears soft and silky, but someone touching it would feel the yowler’s rotten fur and exposed bones. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the yowler’s true appearance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yowler makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. It can use Yowl in place of a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Yowl
actions.description: The yowler lets loose a horrid scream. Each hostile creature within 30 feet of the yowler that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the yowler's Yowl for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Dream Leap
traits.description: Once on its turn, the yumerai can use half its movement to step magically into the dreams of a sleeping creature within 5 feet of it. It emerges from the dreams of another sleeping creature within 1 mile of the first sleeper, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second sleeper. If there is no other sleeping creature within range when it uses this trait, the yumerai is stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The yumerai’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, message, minor illusion
3/day each: detect thoughts, silent image, sleep
1/day each: confusion, major image

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yumerai makes two psychic lash attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Lash
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Somnambulism
actions.description: The yumerai targets one sleeping creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The yumerai can issue simple commands to the creature, such as 'Attack that creature,' 'Run over there,' or 'Fetch that object.' If the creature takes damage, receives a suicidal command, is told to move into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, or is grappled while carrying out the order, it can make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, awakening and ending the yumerai's control on a success. The yumerai can control only one sleeping creature at a time. If it takes control of another, the effect on the previous target ends.

monster:tob2:zalikum.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 10 ft.
monster:tob2:zalikum.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob2:zalikum.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:zalikum.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The zalikum doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Ghastly Heated Body
traits.description: A creature that touches the zalikum or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: The zalikum can store the souls of up to 3 victims inside it at one time. If it has at least 1 soul, a destroyed zalikum gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of its sandy remains. If its sandy remains are soaked with holy water and buried in consecrated ground, its trapped souls are freed, and the zalikum can’t rejuvenate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zalikum makes one beak attack and one talon attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If a creature is slain by this attack, its body crumbles to sand, and the zalikum stores its soul. The creature can be restored to life only if the zalikum is destroyed and can't rejuvenate (see the Rejuvenation trait).

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death-infused Desert Breath
actions.description: The zalikum exhales superheated sand infused with the power of damned souls in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature's saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature also suffers one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned this way, the target is blind and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is blinded and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob:zaratan.damageResistances: fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing

traits.name: Endless Breath
traits.description: The zaratan breathes air, but it can hold its breath for years.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the zaratan remains motionless on the surface of the ocean (except for drifting) it is indistinguishable from a small island.

traits.name: Fortified Shell
traits.description: The zaratan ignores any attack against its shell that doesn't do 30 points of damage or more. Attacking the zaratan's head or flippers bypasses this trait.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The zaratan does double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack and two flipper attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and the zaratan can't bite another target.

actions.name: Flipper
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the zaratan.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack against a Huge or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes 26 (3d10 + 10) piercing damage, is swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, but has total cover against attacks and effects outside the zaratan. A swallowed creature takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zaratan's turns. The zaratan can have any number of creatures swallowed at once. If the zaratan takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the zaratan must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the zaratan. If the zaratan dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Swipe
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan makes one flipper attack.

legendaryActions.name: Consume
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack or uses Swallow.

traits.name: Darting Escape (Darting Form Only)
traits.description: The zeitgeist can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Timewarped Body
traits.description:
At the start of each of the zeitgeist’s turns, roll a die. On an even roll, its body stretches and speeds up as it takes on a darting form. On an odd roll, its body becomes more solid and slows down as it takes on a sluggish form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except as noted here.
 Darting Form. While in a Darting form, the zeitgeist’s Armor Class increases by 2, and its speed is 40 feet.
 Sluggish Form. While in a Sluggish form, the zeitgeist has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and its speed is 20 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: In its darting form, the zeitgeist makes three darting rend attacks. In its sluggish form, the zeitgeist makes two sluggish slam attacks.

actions.name: Darting Rend
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

actions.name: Sluggish Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 feet., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage. If the zeitgeist scores a critical hit, the target is also knocked prone.

actions.name: Tormented Scream
actions.description: The zeitgeist cries out, releasing some of its internal torment in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Rewind
reactions.description: When the zeitgeist takes damage or when it starts its turn afflicted with a condition, it can rewind time around it, preventing the damage or undoing the condition. It can use this reaction even while paralyzed or stunned.

monster:tob3:zilaq.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Eidetic Memory
traits.description: Remembers everything it hears or reads. It has advantage on Int (Arcana) and Int (History) checks.

traits.name: Two-Headed
traits.description: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks and on saves vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zimwi makes one claws attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the zimwi, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zimwi, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. If the zimwi's stomach takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the zimwi must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 5 feet of the zimwi. Damage done to a zimwi's stomach does not harm the zimwi. The zimwi's stomach is larger on the inside than the outside. It can have two Medium creatures or four Small or smaller creatures swallowed at one time. If the zimwi dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the zimwi isn't already grappling a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 11).

traits.name: Desperate Hunger
traits.description: When the zimwi is below half its hp maximum, it has advantage on melee attack rolls against creatures that aren’t Constructs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zimwi makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The zimwi has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The zimwi makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zimwi, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. A zimwi can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time.

monster:ccdx:ziphius.damageResistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the ziphius moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a dorsal fin attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 (5d10) slashing damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The ziphius deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Telepathic Foresight
traits.description: As a bonus action at the start of its turn, the ziphius can choose one creature within 120 feet that it can see. The ziphius' eyes glow, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or the ziphius creates a temporary mental bond with the target until the start of the ziphius' next turn. While bonded, the ziphius reads the creature's surface thoughts, choosing to either gain advantage on attacks against that target or cause the target to have disadvantage on attacks against the ziphius.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The ziphius can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ziphius makes one beak attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the ziphius. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the ziphius, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the ziphius' turns. The ziphius can have only one target swallowed at a time.

If the ziphius takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the ziphius must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the ziphius. If the ziphius dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Dorsal Fin
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

monster:tob:zmey.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 30 ft.
monster:tob:zmey.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 90 ft., passive Perception 18

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The zmey can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Lake Leap
traits.description: A zmey spends much of its time lurking in lakes and ponds. When submerged in a natural pool of standing water, it can transport itself as a bonus action to a similar body of water within 5,000 feet. Rapidly flowing water doesn't serve for this ability, but the zmey can leap to or from a river or stream where the water is calm and slow-moving.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the zmey fails a saving throw, it can count it as a success instead.

traits.name: Multiheaded
traits.description: The zmey normally has three heads. While it has more than one head, the zmey has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and stunned. If the zmey takes 40 or more damage in a single turn (and the damage isn't poison or psychic), one of its heads is severed. If all three of its heads are severed, the zmey dies.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The zmey regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If the zmey takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the zmey's next turn. Regeneration stops functioning when all heads are severed. It takes 24 hours for a zmey to regrow a functional head.

traits.name: Spawn Headling
traits.description: The severed head of a zmey grows into a zmey headling 2d6 rounds after being separated from the body. Smearing at least a pound of salt on the severed head's stump prevents this transformation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zmey makes one bite attack per head and one claws attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The zmey breathes up to three 60-foot cones of fire, one from each of its heads. Creatures in a cone take 16 (3d10) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. If cones overlap, their damage adds together but each target makes only one saving throw. A zmey can choose whether this attack harms plants or plant creatures.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.description: The zmey makes a bite attack.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack
legendaryActions.description: The zmey makes a tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Trample
legendaryActions.description: The zmey moves up to half its land speed. It can enter enemy-occupied spaces but can't end its move there. Creatures in spaces the zmey enters must make successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throws or take 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

monster:tob-2023:zmey.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 30 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:tob-2023:zmey.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 90 ft., passive Perception 18

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The zmey can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the zmey fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The zmey regains 15 hp at the start of its turn. If the zmey takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of the zmey’s next turn. The zmey dies if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn’t regenerate.

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.description: The zmey has three heads. While it has more than one head, the zmey has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. Whenever the zmey takes 40 damage or more in a single turn, one of its heads is severed. If it has only one head remaining, dealing 40 damage or more to it doesn’t sever the final head. It regrows any severed heads when it finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zmey makes two Claw attacks and as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The zmey exhales fire in a 30-foot cone out of each of its heads. Each creature in a cone must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 (14d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the cones overlap, each creature in the overlapping cones must make one saving throw with disadvantage against only one of the cones rather than one saving throw for each cone. The zmey can choose for this breath to not harm plants or Plant creatures.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The zmey moves up to its speed, or flies up to half its flying speed, without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Whip
legendaryActions.description: The zmey whips its tail around it. Each creature within 15 feet of the zmey must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

legendaryActions.name: Tripartite Roar
legendaryActions.description: The zmey's heads exhale a three-part roar, one a deafening shriek, one a frightful screech, and one a stunning bellow, in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or suffer the effects of the roars until the end of its next turn. The effects depend upon the number of heads the zmey has remaining: deafened for only one head, deafened and frightened for two heads, or stunned for three heads.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The zmey headling can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The zmey headling reaver regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. This trait doesn't function if the zmey headling took acid or fire damage since the end of its previous turn. It dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zmey headline makes one bite attack and one claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The zmey headling exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area takes 16 (3d10) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The zmey headling can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: As the zmey, but it regains only 10 hp at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zmey headling makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The zmey headling exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The headling can choose for this breath to not harm plants or Plant creatures.

monster:a5e-mm:zombie.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude (1/Day)
traits.description: If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage that isnt radiant or from a critical hit, its instead reduced to 1 hit point, falls prone, and is stunned until the end of its next turn, appearing to be dead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: A zombie doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 11). Until the grapple ends  the zombie can't grab another target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage  and the zombie regains the same number of hit points.

monster:bfrd:zombie.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it must make a CON save with a DC equal to 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 HP instead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Undead Resilience
traits.description: The zombie is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature, and the zombie doesn't already have a creature grappled.

bonusActions.name: Rotten Hold
bonusActions.description: The zombie gnaws idly on the creature grappled by it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 CON save or take 2 (1d4) poison damage. A Humanoid slain by this bonus action rises 24 hours later as a zombie, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

monster:a5e-mm:zombie-horde.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Area Vulnerability
traits.description: The horde takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

traits.name: Horde
traits.description: The horde is composed of 5 or more zombies. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects. The horde can move through any opening large enough for one Medium creature without squeezing.

traits.name: Horde Dispersal
traits.description: When the horde is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 2 (1d4) zombies with 7 hit points each.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: A zombie doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 11).

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage  and the horde regains the same number of hit points.

monster:a5e-mm:zombie-knight.languages: understands one language but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Nature

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zombie makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword

actions.name: Grab

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by a zombie. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage  and the zombie regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Firesight
traits.description: Can see through areas obscured by fire smoke and fog with o penalty.

traits.name: Smoldering Death
traits.description: When it dies its body crumbles into smoldering coals releasing a great plume of smoke that fills 15 ft. radius sphere centered on zombie’s corpse and spreads around corners. Area is heavily obscured and difficult terrain. When creature enters area for first time on a turn or starts its turn there: 7 (2d6) poison (DC 14 Con half). Smoke lasts for 1 min or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hr) disperses it.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hp it must make a Con save with DC of 5+the damage taken unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success the zombie drops to 1 hp instead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: Erratic Movement
traits.description: Opportunity attacks vs. the voidclaw zombie are made with disadvantage.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: Advantage: saves vs. turn undead effects.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hp it must make a Con save with DC of 5+the damage taken unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success the zombie drops to 1 hp instead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.description: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Fighter
bonusActions.description: Takes Dash or Disengage action.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

monster:ccdx:zoryas.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 40 ft., Swim 15 ft.
monster:ccdx:zoryas.damageResistances: fire, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nomagical attacks

traits.name: Fire and Light
traits.description: The zoryas' weapon attacks are magical. When the zoryas hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant or fire damage (included in the attack). The zoryas chooses whether its attack does radiant or fire damage before making the attack roll.

traits.name: Open Celestial Gate
traits.description: As an action, the zoryas opens a gateway to the celestial plane. The gate appears as a shimmering circle that sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet and is framed by twisting, golden strands. The gate lasts 1 hour; though, the zoryas can choose to close it at any time as a bonus action. Once the gate closes, the zoryas is reduced to 0 hp and remains unconscious for six days, awakening, fully restored, at sunrise on the seventh day. The zoryas can't pass through its own gate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The zoryas regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the zoryas takes necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the zoryas' next turn. The zoryas' body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sun's Guidance (3/Day)
traits.description: The zoryas has advantage on melee attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angel makes two morningstar attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant or fire damage.

actions.name: Light of Dawn
actions.description: The zoryas' lantern brightens, bathing its environs in brilliant light. Each creature within 30 feet of the zoryas must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1d4 rounds. An undead creature who fails this save also takes 13 (3d8) fire damage. The light dispels up to three spells or other magical effects of 3rd level or lower like the dispel magic spell within the area.

actions.name: Dusk's Arrival
actions.description: The zoryas' lantern darkens, snuffing out nearby natural and magical sources of light. Each creature within 30 feet of the zoryas must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area is bathed in darkness like the darkness spell until the end of the zoryas' next turn.

traits.name: Distance Runner
traits.description: The zouyu is capable of incredibly fast long-distance travel. When traveling at a fast pace, the zouyu can run 310 miles per day.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The zouyu has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the zouyu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the zouyu can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zouyu uses Alter Luck. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Alter Luck
actions.description:
The zouyu flicks its vibrant, multi-stranded tail and alters the luck of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it, choosing one of the following luck options. The zouyu can't target itself with Alter Luck.
 Bestow Luck. The target has advantage on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw (zouyu's choice) it makes before the end of its next turn.
 Steal Luck. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw (zouyu's choice) it makes before the end of its next turn. If the target fails the saving throw, the zouyu has advantage on one attack roll or saving throw it makes before the start of its next turn.

features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.description: While raging, the first creature you hit on your turn has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn, and anyone else it hits has resistance to that attack's damage. Ends early if your rage ends.

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.description: While raging, when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 2d6 (3d6 at 10th level, 4d6 at 14th).

features.name: Consult the Spirits
features.description: Cast augury or clairvoyance without a slot or material components (Wisdom); clairvoyance summons an invisible ancestral spirit instead of a sensor. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Vengeful Ancestors
features.description: When Spirit Shield reduces an attack's damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount prevented.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.description: While raging, a 10-foot aura activates on entering rage and again as a bonus action each turn; save DC 8 + proficiency + Con. Choose an environment (change on leveling): Desert, other creatures in the aura take 2 fire (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th); Sea, one creature makes a Dex save, 1d6 lightning, half on success (2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th); Tundra, chosen creatures gain 2 temporary HP (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th).

features.name: Storm Soul
features.description: Desert: fire resistance, ignore extreme heat, set an unattended flammable object alight with an action. Sea: lightning resistance, breathe underwater, swim speed 30 feet. Tundra: cold resistance, ignore extreme cold, freeze a 5-foot cube of water for 1 minute with an action.

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.description: Creatures of your choice in your aura share your Storm Soul resistance.

features.name: Raging Storm
features.description: Desert: after a creature in your aura hits you, reaction for a Dex save or fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: after you hit a creature in your aura, reaction for a Str save or it falls prone. Tundra: each time the aura activates, one creature in it makes a Str save or its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Medium armor and the scimitar; a proficient simple or martial melee weapon can be your bard spellcasting focus.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description: When you take the Attack action, +10 feet walking speed this turn; once per turn on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration die for extra damage equal to the roll plus one flourish: Defensive (add the roll to AC until your next turn), Slashing (same damage to another creature within 5 feet), or Mobile (push 5 feet plus the roll, then reaction to move your speed to a space within 5 feet of the target).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.description: Roll a d6 for a Blade Flourish instead of spending Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Once per round on your turn, on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration for an extra 2d6 psychic (3d6 at 5th, 5d6 at 10th, 8d6 at 15th).

features.name: Words of Terror
features.description: After talking 1 minute alone with a humanoid, it makes a Wis save or is frightened of you or another creature you choose for 1 hour or until it or an ally is attacked or damaged. Failed targets don't know. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Whispers
features.description: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 feet: capture its shadow until a long rest. As an action, become a disguise of that person for 1 hour, with what it would share with a casual acquaintance; Insight vs your Deception +5 sees through it. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Shadow Lore
features.description: Action, one creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you makes a Wis save or is charmed for 8 hours (ends if you or allies harm it or force a save), believing you know its deepest secret; it obeys you short of risking its life. Once per long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: identify, searing smite (1st); heat metal, magic weapon (3rd); elemental weapon, protection from energy (5th); fabricate, wall of fire (7th); animate objects, creation (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Heavy armor and smith's tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.description: At the end of a long rest, touch a nonmagical suit of armor or simple or martial weapon: it becomes magic (+1 AC, or +1 to attack and damage) until your next long rest or your death.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.description: A 1-hour ritual crafts a nonmagical metal-containing item worth up to 100 gp (weapon, armor, ten ammunition, tools, other metal object), consuming metal or coins of equal value; can duplicate a metal item you hold, such as a key.

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.description: Resistance to fire damage; +1 AC while wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 fire (2d8 at 14th level).

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.description: Immunity to fire damage; while wearing heavy armor, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.description: A pool of d6s equal to your druid level, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: spend up to half your druid level in dice on a creature within 120 feet; it regains the total in HP plus 1 temporary HP per die.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.description: At the start of a rest, an invisible 30-foot-radius sphere: you and allies inside have +5 to Stealth and Perception, and firelight inside isn't visible outside. Ends with the rest or if you leave.

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 60 feet; or action: teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 feet. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.description: After a short rest, cast dream (you as messenger), scrying, or teleportation circle without a slot or material components; the circle opens to where you last finished a long rest on this plane. Once per long rest.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.description: You speak, read and write Sylvan; beasts understand you and you can read their noises and motions.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.description: Bonus action: summon a spirit at a point within 60 feet with a 30-foot aura for 1 minute (bonus action moves it 60 feet). Once per short or long rest. Bear: chosen creatures gain 5 + druid level temporary HP, and you and allies have advantage on Str checks and saves in the aura. Hawk: reaction to give advantage on an attack against a target in the aura; you and allies have advantage on Perception there. Unicorn: advantage on checks to detect creatures in the aura, and when your slotted spell heals anyone, chosen creatures in the aura also regain HP equal to your druid level.

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.description: Beasts and fey your spells summon or create get 2 extra HP per Hit Die, and their natural weapons count as magical.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.description: A beast or fey you summoned that ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura regains HP equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.description: When reduced to 0 HP or incapacitated against your will, gain conjure animals as a 9th-level casting: four beasts of CR 2 or lower within 20 feet protect you for 1 hour, no concentration. Once per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: One of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.description: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount; land on your feet from a fall of 10 feet or less if not incapacitated; mounting or dismounting costs 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon, mark the creature until the end of your next turn: within 5 feet of you it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you. If it damages someone else, on your next turn a bonus-action melee attack against it has advantage and deals extra damage equal to half your fighter level. Str mod special attacks (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 5 feet is hit, while wielding a melee weapon or shield: add 1d8 to the target's AC against it; if it still hits, the target has resistance to that damage. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: Creatures provoke your opportunity attack when they move 5 feet or more within your reach, and a hit reduces their speed to 0 for the turn.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.description: Once per turn, after moving 10 feet straight before a hit, the target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency + Str) or falls prone.

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.description: A special reaction usable once on every other creature's turn, only for an opportunity attack, and not on a turn you use your normal reaction.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: One of History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.description: Bonus action: advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temporary HP (10 at 10th level, 15 at 15th). Three uses per long rest.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to Persuasion checks; proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.description: If you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, regain one.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.description: Once per turn during the Attack action, give up advantage on one attack to make an extra weapon attack against that target.

features.name: Strength before Death
features.description: When damage drops you to 0 HP without killing you, reaction: take an extra turn immediately, interrupting the current one; damage at 0 HP still causes death save failures. Fall unconscious after it if still at 0. Once per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Performance and brewer's supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.description: Flurry of Blows also grants the Disengage action and +10 feet walking speed this turn.

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.description: Stand up from prone for 5 feet of movement. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, spend 1 ki as a reaction to have it hit another creature of your choice within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.description: Spend 2 ki to cancel disadvantage on an ability check, attack roll or saving throw.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.description: Flurry of Blows can make up to three more attacks (five total) if each one targets a different creature this turn.

features.name: Path of the Kensei
features.description: Choose one melee and one ranged kensei weapon (simple or martial without heavy or special; longbow allowed), gaining proficiency; they count as monk weapons. One more at 6th, 11th and 17th. Agile Parry: after an unarmed strike in the Attack action while holding a melee kensei weapon, +2 AC until your next turn. Kensei's Shot: bonus action, ranged kensei hits deal +1d4 this turn. Way of the Brush: calligrapher's or painter's supplies.

features.name: One with the Blade
features.description: Kensei weapon attacks count as magical. Deft Strike: once per turn on a kensei weapon hit, spend 1 ki for extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die.

features.name: Sharpen the Blade
features.description: Bonus action: spend up to 3 ki to give a kensei weapon you touch that bonus to attack and damage for 1 minute (not on a weapon that already has a bonus).

features.name: Unerring Accuracy
features.description: Once per turn, reroll a missed monk weapon attack.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.description: A ranged spell attack option in the Attack action: 30 feet, Dex to attack and damage, radiant, Martial Arts die. After using it in the Attack action, spend 1 ki to make it twice as a bonus action. With Extra Attack, any of your attacks can be this.

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.description: Right after the Attack action, spend 2 ki to cast burning hands as a bonus action, +1 spell level per extra ki (max ki half your monk level).

features.name: Searing Sunburst
features.description: Action: a 20-foot-radius sphere at a point within 150 feet; Con save or 2d6 radiant (opaque total cover protects). Spend up to 3 ki for +2d6 each.

features.name: Sun Shield
features.description: Bright light 30 feet and dim 30 more (toggle as a bonus action). While lit, reaction when hit by a melee attack: deal 5 + Wis mod radiant to the attacker.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Always prepared: armor of Agathys, command (3rd); hold person, spiritual weapon (5th); bestow curse, fear (9th); dominate beast, stoneskin (13th); cloudkill, dominate person (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Conquering Presence: action, chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Guided Strike: +10 to an attack roll after seeing the roll.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.description: A 10-foot aura (30 feet at 18th) while not incapacitated: creatures frightened of you have speed 0 in it and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level when they start their turn there.

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.description: A creature that hits you takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1), if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.description: Action, 1 minute: resistance to all damage, one extra attack in the Attack action, and melee weapon crits on 19 or 20. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Always prepared: sanctuary, sleep (3rd); calm emotions, hold person (5th); counterspell, hypnotic pattern (9th); Otiluke's resilient sphere, stoneskin (13th); hold monster, wall of force (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
