features.description: Emissary of Peace: bonus action, +5 to Persuasion for 10 minutes. Rebuke the Violent: reaction right after an attacker within 30 feet damages someone other than you; it makes a Wis save, taking radiant damage equal to what it dealt, half on a success.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 10 feet (30 at 18th) takes damage: you take that damage instead; it can't be reduced and no other effects transfer.

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.description: If you end your turn in combat below half your hit points and aren't incapacitated, regain 1d6 + half your paladin level HP.

features.name: Emissary of Redemption
features.description: Resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures, and a creature that hits you takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you took. Both stop working against a creature you attack, cast a spell on, or damage, until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Horizon Walker Magic
features.description: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), misty step (5th), haste (9th), banishment (13th), teleportation circle (17th).

features.name: Detect Portal
features.description: Action: learn the distance and direction to the nearest planar portal within 1 mile. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.description: Bonus action, choose a creature within 30 feet: your next weapon hit on it this turn deals all force damage plus 1d8 force (2d8 at 11th).

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.description: Bonus action: cast etherealness without a slot, ending at the end of the turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Distant Strike
features.description: During the Attack action, teleport up to 10 feet before each attack; if you attack two different creatures, make one extra attack against a third.

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.description: Reaction when an attack damages you: resistance to all of that attack's damage this turn.

features.name: Monster Slayer Magic
features.description: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), zone of truth (5th), magic circle (9th), banishment (13th), hold monster (17th).

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.description: Action, a creature within 60 feet: learn its damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities (none, if it is shielded from divination). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.description: Bonus action, mark a creature within 60 feet until a short or long rest or a new mark: the first weapon hit on it each turn deals +1d6.

features.name: Supernatural Defense
features.description: Add 1d6 to saves your Slayer's Prey target forces and to checks to escape its grapple.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell or teleports: Wis save against your spell DC or it fails and is wasted. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.description: When your Slayer's Prey target forces a save, reaction: one weapon attack against it first; on a hit you automatically succeed on the save.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.description: On Insight checks to tell if a creature lies, treat a d20 of 7 or lower as 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: Bonus action: a Perception check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Investigation check for clues.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.description: Bonus action: your Insight vs a visible creature's Deception; on a win you can Sneak Attack it without advantage (not with disadvantage) for 1 minute or until you use this on another target.

features.name: Steady Eye
features.description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation if you move no more than half your speed this turn.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.description: Action: sense illusions, shapechangers in another form, and other deceiving magic within 30 feet, unless blinded or deafened (not what is hidden). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.description: Sneak Attack deals +3d6 against your Insightful Fighting target.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.description: Disguise kit, forgery kit, one gaming set and two languages; after 1 minute of listening you can mimic a creature's speech and accent in a language you know.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: Help as a bonus action; when you help an ally attack, the target can be within 30 feet of you if it can see or hear you.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.description: After 1 minute observing or talking to a creature outside combat, learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two of: Int, Wis, Cha, class levels.

features.name: Misdirection
features.description: Reaction when targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 feet gives you cover: the attack targets that creature instead.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.description: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it, and you can present false thoughts (Deception vs Insight). Truth-detecting magic shows you as truthful if you wish, and magic can't compel you to tell the truth.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.description: Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet: move up to half your speed without provoking.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: Proficiency in Nature and Survival, with double proficiency bonus on checks using them.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.description: +10 feet walking speed, and climbing and swimming speeds if you have them.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.description: Advantage on initiative; attacks against the first creature you hit in the first round have advantage until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.description: When you take the Attack action, one extra attack as a bonus action; it can Sneak Attack even if you already did this turn, but not the same target twice.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: A creature you make a melee attack against can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: Add Cha mod to initiative. Sneak Attack without advantage when you're within 5 feet of the target, no other creature is within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Panache
features.description: Action: Persuasion vs Insight against a creature that hears and understands you. Hostile: for 1 minute it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can only make opportunity attacks against you (ends if an ally attacks or spells it, or you're 60+ feet apart). Not hostile: charmed for 1 minute as a friendly acquaintance, ending if harmed.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.description: Bonus action: advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.description: Reroll a missed attack with advantage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: When you learn or replace a sorcerer spell or cantrip, you can pick from the cleric list; it becomes a sorcerer spell. Pick an affinity for a bonus spell that doesn't count against spells known: good cure wounds, evil inflict wounds, law bless, chaos bane, neutrality protection from evil and good.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.description: When you fail a save or miss an attack, add 2d4 to the total. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.description: Once per turn, when you or an ally within 5 feet rolls healing dice for a spell, spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any of them once, if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.description: Bonus action: spectral wings give a 30-foot flying speed until you're incapacitated, die or dismiss them.

features.name: Unearthly Recovery
features.description: Bonus action below half your hit points: regain half your hit point maximum. Once per long rest.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.description: Darkvision 120 feet. At 3rd level you learn darkness (not counted against spells known) and can cast it for 2 sorcery points, seeing through it when you do.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.description: When damage drops you to 0 HP, Cha save (DC 5 + damage taken) to drop to 1 HP instead; not against radiant damage or a critical hit. Once per long rest after a success.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.description: Bonus action, 3 sorcery points: summon a Medium monstrosity dire wolf within 30 feet of a target you can see within 120 feet, with temporary HP equal to half your sorcerer level. It moves through creatures and objects (5 force if it ends in one), always knows the target's location, moves and attacks only that target, and while within 5 feet the target has disadvantage on saves against your spells. Lasts 5 minutes or until it or the target drops to 0.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: teleport up to 120 feet to a space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: Bonus action, 6 sorcery points, 1 minute: resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and move through creatures and objects (5 force if you end a turn inside one).

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.description: Speak, read and write Primordial (understanding Aquan, Auran, Ignan and Terran).

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.description: Bonus action right before or after casting a spell of 1st level or higher: fly up to 10 feet without provoking.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.description: Resistance to lightning and thunder. When you start casting a 1st-level-plus spell that deals lightning or thunder, chosen creatures within 10 feet take lightning or thunder damage equal to half your sorcerer level.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.description: Action: stop rain in a 20-foot sphere around you. Bonus action each round: set the wind's direction in a 100-foot sphere until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.description: Reaction when hit by a melee attack: lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level to the attacker, and a Str save against your spell DC or it is pushed up to 20 feet.

features.name: Wind Soul
features.description: Immunity to lightning and thunder; magical flying speed 60 feet. Action: drop to 30 feet for 1 hour to give 3 + Cha mod creatures within 30 feet a 30-foot flying speed for 1 hour. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: cure wounds, guiding bolt (1st); flaming sphere, lesser restoration (2nd); daylight, revivify (3rd); guardian of faith, wall of fire (4th); flame strike, greater restoration (5th).

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.description: Light and sacred flame, not counted against cantrips known.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: A pool of 1 + warlock level d6s, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: heal a creature within 60 feet, spending up to Cha mod dice (min 1).

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Resistance to radiant; add Cha mod to one radiant or fire damage roll of your spells against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: After a short or long rest, gain temporary HP equal to warlock level + Cha mod, and up to five creatures you can see gain half your warlock level + Cha mod.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: Instead of a death save at the start of your turn, regain half your hit point maximum and stand if you like; chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d8 + Cha mod radiant and are blinded until the end of the turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: shield, wrathful smite (1st); blur, branding smite (2nd); blink, elemental weapon (3rd); phantasmal killer, staggering smite (4th); banishing smite, cone of cold (5th).

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: Bonus action, curse a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: add proficiency bonus to damage against it, your attacks against it crit on 19 or 20, and if it dies you regain warlock level + Cha mod HP (min 1). Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons. After a long rest, touch a proficient weapon without two-handed: use Cha for its attack and damage until the next long rest; with Pact of the Blade this applies to every pact weapon.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: When you slay a humanoid, its spirit rises as a specter with temporary HP equal to half your warlock level and a bonus to attacks equal to your Cha mod; it obeys you until your next long rest. Once per long rest.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: Reaction when your cursed target hits you: roll a d6, and on 4 or higher the attack misses.

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.description: When your cursed target dies, move the curse to another creature within 30 feet (without regaining HP from the death).

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.description: Reaction when hit or when you fail a save: +2 AC against that attack or +4 to that save; then only cantrips until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Tactical Wit
features.description: Add Int mod to initiative.

features.name: Power Surge
features.description: Hold up to Int mod (min 1) power surges; reset to one on a long rest, gain one when you end a spell with dispel magic or counterspell, and one after a short rest if you have none. Once per turn when a wizard spell damages a target, spend one for extra force damage equal to half your wizard level.

features.name: Durable Magic
features.description: +2 to AC and all saves while concentrating on a spell.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud
features.description: When you use Arcane Deflection, up to three creatures within 60 feet take force damage equal to half your wizard level.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.description: When you rage, manifest a natural weapon (simple melee, Str) chosen each rage: Bite 1d8 piercing, once per turn regain HP equal to proficiency bonus if below half HP; Claws 1d6 slashing, one extra claw attack when you attack with a claw in the Attack action; Tail 1d8 piercing with reach, and reaction when a creature within 10 feet hits you to add 1d8 to AC.

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.description: Natural weapons count as magical. After a short or long rest pick one until the next: swim speed and water breathing; climb speed with spider climbing; or once per turn add a Str (Athletics) check total to a jump's distance.

features.name: Infectious Fury
features.description: While raging, on a natural weapon hit the target makes a Wis save (DC 8 + Con + proficiency) or, your choice, uses its reaction to make a melee attack against a creature you choose, or takes 2d12 psychic. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.description: When you rage, up to Con mod (min 1) willing creatures within 30 feet join: you gain 5 temporary HP per creature, and each can add 1d6 to one attack's damage per turn until the rage ends. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.description: Action: until the end of your next turn, know the location and school of spells and magic items within 60 feet not behind total cover. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Wild Surge
features.description: When you rage, roll a d8 (save DC 8 + proficiency + Con): 1 chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save or take 1d12 necrotic, and you gain 1d12 temporary HP; 2 teleport 30 feet, repeatable as a bonus action each turn; 3 an exploding spirit next to a creature within 30 feet, Dex save or 1d6 force, repeatable as a bonus action; 4 a held weapon deals force, gains light and thrown (20/60) and returns to your hand; 5 attackers who hit you take 1d6 force; 6 +1 AC for you and allies within 10 feet; 7 the ground within 15 feet is difficult terrain for enemies; 8 a creature within 30 feet makes a Con save or takes 1d6 radiant and is blinded until your next turn, repeatable as a bonus action. Each lasts until the rage ends.

features.name: Bolstering Magic
features.description: Action, touch a creature (or yourself): either add 1d3 to attack rolls and ability checks for 10 minutes, or it regains a spell slot of level 1d3 or lower (once per long rest per creature). Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.description: While raging, reaction right after you take damage or fail a save: roll a new Wild Surge, replacing the current one.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.description: Roll Wild Surge twice and choose; on a matching roll pick any effect.

features.name: Mote of Potential
features.description: When you give Bardic Inspiration, a mote orbits the creature until the die is used. Ability check: roll the die twice and pick. Attack roll: the target and chosen creatures within 5 feet of it make a Con save against your spell DC or take thunder damage equal to the roll. Saving throw: the creature gains temporary HP equal to the roll + your Cha mod (min 1).

features.name: Performance of Creation
features.description: Action: create one nonmagical Medium or smaller item worth up to 20 x bard level gp within 10 feet, lasting proficiency bonus hours (one at a time; Large at 6th, Huge at 14th). Once per long rest, or spend a 2nd-level or higher slot.

features.name: Animating Performance
features.description: Action: animate a Large or smaller unattended nonmagical item within 30 feet as a Dancing Item for 1 hour (AC 16, HP 10 + 5 x bard level, speed 30, fly 30 hover; slam with your spell attack, 1d10 + PB force; nearby creatures' speed can change by 10 feet). It acts after you and Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action (or with your Bardic Inspiration bonus action). Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

features.name: Creative Crescendo
features.description: Performance of Creation makes up to Cha mod items (min 2), only one of maximum size, with no gp limit.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.description: Treat a d20 of 9 or lower on Persuasion or Deception as a 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.description: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration on a creature within 60 feet: it subtracts the roll from its next save before your next turn.

features.name: Unfailing Inspiration
features.description: A creature that adds your Bardic Inspiration and still fails keeps the die.

features.name: Universal Speech
features.description: Action: up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 60 feet understand you for 1 hour. Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot.

features.name: Infectious Inspiration
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet succeeds using your Bardic Inspiration: give a free die to another creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Cha mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: command, heroism (1st); hold person, zone of truth (3rd); mass healing word, slow (5th); compulsion, locate creature (7th); commune, dominate person (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Heavy armor, and Intimidation or Persuasion.

features.name: Voice of Authority
features.description: When your 1st-level or higher spell targets an ally, that ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against a creature you choose.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
features.description: Action: chosen creatures within 30 feet that see or hear you make a Wis save or are charmed until the end of your next turn or until damaged, and you can make them drop what they hold.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law
features.description: Cast a 1st-level or higher enchantment spell with a 1-action casting time as a bonus action. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 psychic (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Order's Wrath
features.description: When your Divine Strike damages a creature, curse it until your next turn: the next ally hit on it deals an extra 2d8 psychic.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: heroism, sanctuary (1st); aid, warding bond (3rd); beacon of hope, sending (5th); aura of purity, Otiluke's resilient sphere (7th); greater restoration, Rary's telepathic bond (9th).

features.name: Implement of Peace
features.description: Proficiency in Insight, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Emboldening Bond
features.description: Action: bond up to proficiency bonus willing creatures within 30 feet (yourself included) for 10 minutes; while within 30 feet of another bonded creature, each can add 1d4 to one attack, check or save per turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
features.description: Action: move your speed without provoking; each creature you pass within 5 feet of regains 2d6 + Wis mod HP (min 1), once each.

features.name: Protective Bond
features.description: When a bonded creature is about to take damage, another bonded creature within 30 feet can use its reaction to teleport within 5 feet of it and take all the damage instead.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add Wis mod to cleric cantrip damage.

features.name: Expansive Bond
features.description: Emboldening and Protective Bond work within 60 feet, and a creature taking damage through Protective Bond has resistance to it.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: faerie fire, sleep (1st); moonbeam, see invisibility (3rd); aura of vitality, Leomund's tiny hut (5th); aura of life, greater invisibility (7th); circle of power, mislead (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.description: Darkvision 300 feet, seeing dim light as bright and darkness as dim. Action: share it with up to Wis mod (min 1) willing creatures within 10 feet for 1 hour, once per long rest or by spending a spell slot.

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.description: Action: a creature you touch has advantage on its next initiative roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.description: Action: a 30-foot sphere of dim light moves with you for 1 minute; a creature ending its turn in it gains 1d6 + cleric level temporary HP or ends one charmed or frightened effect.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.description: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: flying speed equal to walking speed for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.description: You and allies have half cover inside your Twilight Sanctuary.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Chill touch at 2nd. Always prepared: blindness/deafness, gentle repose (3rd); animate dead, gaseous form (5th); blight, confusion (7th); cloudkill, contagion (9th).

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.description: Reaction when a creature you can see moves within 10 feet or starts its turn there: Con save against your spell DC or 1d4 necrotic (1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 14th).

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.description: Action, spend a Wild Shape use: gain 4 temporary HP per druid level; for 10 minutes (or until those HP are gone or you Wild Shape) Halo of Spores rolls its die twice and your melee weapon hits deal +1d6 necrotic.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.description: Reaction when a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet: it rises as a zombie with 1 HP for 1 hour, acting after you and only able to make one melee attack. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.description: While Symbiotic Entity is active, bonus action: a 10-foot cube of spores within 30 feet for 1 minute; a creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Con save or takes your Halo damage (once per turn). You can't use the Halo reaction while it lasts.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.description: Immune to blinded, deafened, frightened and poisoned; critical hits against you become normal hits unless you're incapacitated.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: A Tiny star chart that is a druid focus. While holding it: you know guidance, guiding bolt is always prepared, and you can cast guiding bolt without a slot proficiency bonus times per long rest. A 1-hour ceremony during a rest replaces it.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: Bonus action, spend a Wild Shape use: glow for 10 minutes (bright 10 feet, dim 10 more) with a constellation. Archer: on activation and as a bonus action each turn, ranged spell attack within 60 feet for 1d8 + Wis radiant. Chalice: when a slotted spell heals, you or a creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Wis. Dragon: treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower on Int and Wis checks and concentration saves as 10.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: After a long rest, roll a die: even (Weal) lets you add 1d6, odd (Woe) subtract 1d6, as a reaction to an attack, save or check by a creature within 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: Archer and Chalice become 2d8; Dragon grants a 20-foot flying speed with hover; you can switch constellation at the start of each of your turns.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: In Starry Form, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Always prepared: burning hands, cure wounds (2nd); flaming sphere, scorching ray (3rd); plant growth, revivify (5th); aura of life, fire shield (7th); flame strike, mass cure wounds (9th).

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.description: Action, spend a Wild Shape use: a wildfire spirit appears within 30 feet for 1 hour, and creatures within 10 feet of it make a Dex save or take 2d6 fire. Small elemental, AC 13, HP 5 + 5 x druid level, speed 30, fly 30 hover; Flame Seed (spell attack, 60 feet, 1d6 + PB fire); Fiery Teleportation (it and willing creatures within 5 feet teleport 15 feet, then Dex save or 1d6 + PB fire for creatures near where it left). It acts after you and Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.description: While the spirit is summoned, add 1d8 to one damage or healing roll of your fire-damage or healing spells, and your ranged spells can originate from the spirit.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.description: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or the spirit, a spectral flame stays for 1 minute; reaction when a creature enters it: heal it or deal fire damage, 2d10 + Wis mod. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Blazing Revival
features.description: When you drop to 0 HP with the spirit within 120 feet, it drops to 0 instead and you regain half your hit points and stand. Once per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Smith's tools; speak, read and write Giant.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.description: Know 2 runes (3 at 7th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th; swap one per level). After a long rest, inscribe each on a different worn or held object. Each invokes once per short or long rest; save DC 8 + proficiency + Con. Cloud: advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception; reaction to redirect an attack hitting you or a creature within 30 feet to another creature within 30 feet. Fire: double proficiency on tool checks; on a weapon hit, +2d6 fire and Str save or restrained 1 minute taking 2d6 fire each turn (save ends). Frost: advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation; bonus action, +2 to Str and Con checks and saves for 10 minutes. Stone: advantage on Insight, darkvision 120 feet; reaction when a creature ends its turn within 30 feet, Wis save or charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated for 1 minute (save ends). Hill (7th): advantage on saves against poison and poison resistance; bonus action, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 1 minute. Storm (7th): advantage on Arcana and can't be surprised; bonus action for 1 minute, reaction to give advantage or disadvantage to a roll within 60 feet.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute: become Large if there's room, advantage on Str checks and saves, and once per turn +1d6 on a weapon or unarmed hit. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet is hit: the attacker rerolls the d20. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Great Stature
features.description: Grow 3d4 inches; Giant's Might extra damage becomes 1d8.

features.name: Master of Runes
features.description: Each rune can be invoked twice per short or long rest.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut
features.description: Giant's Might deals 1d10 and can make you Huge with +5 feet reach.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: Insight, Medicine and the herbalism kit, plus a mercy mask.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: Action, 1 ki: touch a creature to restore Martial Arts die + Wis HP. In Flurry of Blows, replace one strike with it at no ki.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Once per turn on an unarmed hit, 1 ki: extra necrotic equal to Martial Arts die + Wis.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.description: Hand of Healing also ends one disease or blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned. Hand of Harm can poison the target until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.description: In Flurry of Blows, replace each strike with Hand of Healing for free, and use Hand of Harm on a Flurry strike without ki (still once per turn).

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.description: Action, 5 ki: a creature dead under 24 hours returns with 4d10 + Wis HP, free of blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned and stunned. Once per long rest.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self
features.description: Bonus action, 1 ki, 10 minutes: chosen creatures within 10 feet make a Dex save or take two Martial Arts dice of force. While active, use Wis for Str checks and saves; unarmed strikes with the arms have +5 feet reach on your turn, can use Wis for attack and damage, and deal force.

features.name: Visage of the Astral Self
features.description: Bonus action (or with the arms), 1 ki, 10 minutes: see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet, advantage on Insight and Intimidation, and speak to only one creature within 60 feet or be heard to 600 feet.

features.name: Body of the Astral Self
features.description: With arms and visage active: reaction to reduce acid, cold, fire, force, lightning or thunder damage by 1d10 + Wis (min 1), and once per turn an arms hit deals an extra Martial Arts die.

features.name: Awakened Astral Self
features.description: Bonus action, 5 ki: arms, visage and body for 10 minutes, plus +2 AC and three attacks instead of two with Extra Attack when all use the arms.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Always prepared: alarm, detect magic (3rd); moonbeam, see invisibility (5th); counterspell, nondetection (9th); aura of purity, banishment (13th); hold monster, scrying (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Watcher's Will: action, you and up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 30 feet have advantage on Int, Wis and Cha saves for 1 minute. Abjure the Extraplanar: action, aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends within 30 feet that hear you make a Wis save or are turned for 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.description: While not incapacitated, you and chosen creatures within 10 feet (30 at 18th) add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke
features.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet succeeds on an Int, Wis or Cha save: the creature that forced it takes 2d8 + Cha mod force.

features.name: Mortal Bulwark
features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute: truesight 120 feet, advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, and on a damaging hit the target makes a Cha save against your spell DC or is banished to its native plane (a success makes it immune for 24 hours). Once per long rest, or spend a 5th-level slot.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.description: Once per turn right after you hit with an attack: the target takes 1d6 piercing; or it makes a Str save against your spell DC or is moved 15 feet horizontally; or you move 5 feet horizontally.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.description: Mage hand, plus known extra spells: faerie fire (3rd), web (5th), gaseous form (9th), arcane eye (13th), insect plague (17th).

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.description: Bonus action: 10-foot flying speed with hover for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Mighty Swarm
features.description: Gathered Swarm deals 1d8; a creature failing the move save can also be knocked prone; moving yourself grants half cover until your next turn.

features.name: Swarming Dispersal
features.description: Reaction when you take damage: resistance to it, then teleport up to 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: Known extra spells, swappable on level up for a divination or enchantment of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock or wizard list: arms of Hadar, dissonant whispers, mind sliver (1st); calm emotions, detect thoughts (3rd); hunger of Hadar, sending (5th); Evard's black tentacles, summon aberration (7th); Rary's telepathic bond, telekinesis (9th).

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: Bonus action, a creature within 30 feet: telepathy within Cha mod miles (min 1) for sorcerer level minutes, in a shared language.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: Cast a Psionic Spell by spending sorcery points equal to its level instead of a slot, with no verbal, somatic or unconsumed material components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: Resistance to psychic; advantage on saves against charmed and frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description: Bonus action, 10 minutes, one benefit per sorcery point: see invisible creatures within 60 feet; flying speed equal to walking with hover; swim speed twice walking and water breathing; squeeze through 1-inch gaps and escape nonmagical restraints or grapples for 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: Action: teleport up to 120 feet; creatures within 30 feet of where you left make a Str save or take 3d10 force and are pulled toward that space, half and no pull on a success. Once per long rest, or 5 sorcery points.

features.name: Clockwork Magic
features.description: Known extra spells, swappable on level up for an abjuration or transmutation of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock or wizard list: alarm, protection from evil and good (1st); aid, lesser restoration (3rd); dispel magic, protection from energy (5th); freedom of movement, summon construct (7th); greater restoration, wall of force (9th).

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage: it rolls normally. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: Action, 1 to 5 sorcery points: a ward of that many d8s on you or a creature within 30 feet, lasting until your next long rest or new ward; the warded creature spends dice to reduce damage it takes.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute: attacks against you can't have advantage, and you treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower on attacks, checks and saves as 10. Once per long rest, or 5 sorcery points.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.description: Action, a 30-foot cube from you: restore up to 100 HP split among chosen creatures, repair damaged objects entirely inside, and end spells of 6th level or lower on chosen creatures and objects. Once per long rest, or 7 sorcery points.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: create or destroy water, thunderwave (1st); gust of wind, silence (2nd); lightning bolt, sleet storm (3rd); control water, summon elemental (water only) (4th); Bigby's hand, cone of cold (5th).

features.name: Tentacle of the Deeps
features.description: Bonus action: a 10-foot tentacle at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute; melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of it for 1d8 cold (2d8 at 10th) and -10 feet speed until your next turn. Bonus action each turn: move it 30 feet and attack again. Proficiency bonus summons per long rest.

features.name: Gift of the Sea
features.description: Swim speed 40 feet and water breathing.

features.name: Oceanic Soul
features.description: Resistance to cold. While fully submerged, you and other submerged creatures understand each other's speech.

features.name: Guardian Coil
features.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet of the tentacle takes damage: reduce it by 1d8 (2d8 at 10th).

features.name: Grasping Tentacles
features.description: Know Evard's black tentacles (not counted), castable once per long rest without a slot; casting it gives temporary HP equal to your warlock level, and damage can't break concentration on it.

features.name: Fathomless Plunge
features.description: Action: you and up to five willing creatures within 30 feet teleport up to 1 mile to a body of water you've seen (pond or larger) or within 30 feet of it. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Choose a patron kind: dao (earth), djinni (air), efreeti (fire) or marid (water). Added to your warlock list: detect evil and good, phantasmal force, create food and water, phantasmal killer, creation, and wish at 9th; plus by kind, dao sanctuary, spike growth, meld into stone, stone shape, wall of stone; djinni thunderwave, gust of wind, wind wall, greater invisibility, seeming; efreeti burning hands, scorching ray, fireball, fire shield, flame strike; marid fog cloud, blur, sleet storm, control water, cone of cold.

features.name: Genie's Vessel
features.description: A Tiny vessel (AC your spell DC, HP warlock level + proficiency, immune to poison and psychic) that is your warlock focus; replace it with a 1-hour ceremony during a rest. Bottled Respite: action, enter its 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high interior for up to twice your proficiency bonus in hours, hearing outside; once per long rest. Genie's Wrath: once per turn on an attack hit, extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus, bludgeoning (dao), thunder (djinni), fire (efreeti) or cold (marid).

features.name: Elemental Gift
features.description: Resistance to your patron's damage type. Bonus action: 30-foot flying speed with hover for 10 minutes, proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Sanctuary Vessel
features.description: Bring up to five willing creatures within 30 feet into the vessel and eject them as a bonus action. Ten minutes inside counts as a short rest, and Hit Dice spent there heal an extra amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Limited Wish
features.description: Action: produce the effect of any spell of 6th level or lower with a 1-action casting time, ignoring its requirements and costly components. Usable again after 1d4 long rests.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.description: Light armor, one one-handed melee weapon type, and Performance.

features.name: Bladesong
features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, without medium or heavy armor or a shield: + Int mod (min 1) to AC and to concentration saves, +10 feet walking speed, advantage on Acrobatics. Ends if incapacitated, you don such armor or a shield, or attack two-handed. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one attack can be a cantrip.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.description: During Bladesong, reaction when you take damage: spend a spell slot to reduce it by 5 x the slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.description: During Bladesong, add Int mod (min 1) to melee weapon damage.

features.name: Wizardly Quill
features.description: Bonus action: create an inkless Tiny quill; copying spells with it takes 2 minutes per spell level, and it can erase its own writing within 5 feet as a bonus action.

features.name: Awakened Spellbook
features.description: While held: it is your focus; a slotted wizard spell can swap its damage type for one from another spell of the same level in the book; once per long rest cast a ritual at its normal casting time. Replace the book over a short rest with the quill.

features.name: Manifest Mind
features.description: Bonus action: the book's spectral mind appears within 60 feet (dim light 10 feet, darkvision 60, shares senses with you, moves 30 feet as a bonus action). Proficiency bonus times per long rest, cast a wizard spell from its space. Ends beyond 300 feet, on dispel magic, or when dismissed. Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot.

features.name: Master Scrivener
features.description: After a long rest, make a scroll of a 1st- or 2nd-level, 1-action spell from your book that casts one level higher, readable only by you and fading after your next long rest. Spell scrolls cost half the gold and time with the quill.

features.name: One with the Word
features.description: Advantage on Arcana while carrying the book. Once per long rest, reaction when you take damage while the mind is manifested: dismiss it to negate the damage; the book loses spells totaling at least 3d6 levels for 1d6 long rests (or you drop to 0 HP if it can't cover the cost).

features.name: Spirit Seeker
features.description: Cast beast sense and speak with animals as rituals only.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.description: Choose a totem (with a physical totem object). Bear: while raging, resistance to all damage except psychic. Eagle: while raging, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action. Wolf: while raging, friends have advantage on melee attacks against hostile creatures within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.description: Choose a totem: Bear, double carrying capacity and advantage on Str checks to push, pull, lift or break; Eagle, see up to 1 mile in fine detail and dim light doesn't hinder Perception; Wolf, track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.

features.name: Spirit Walker
features.description: Cast commune with nature as a ritual only.

features.name: Totemic Attunement
features.description: Choose a totem: Bear, while raging, hostile creatures within 5 feet that can see or hear you (and can be frightened) have disadvantage attacking anyone but you; Eagle, while raging, flying speed equal to walking speed in bursts (you fall if you end your turn aloft); Wolf, while raging, bonus action to knock a Large or smaller creature prone after hitting it with a melee weapon.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: animal friendship, speak with animals (1st); barkskin, spike growth (3rd); plant growth, wind wall (5th); dominate beast, grasping vine (7th); insect plague, tree stride (9th).

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.description: One druid cantrip (as a cleric cantrip, not counted) and one of Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Heavy armor.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
features.description: Action: beasts and plants within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are charmed for 1 minute or until damaged, friendly to you and those you choose.

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: grant resistance to it.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 cold, fire or lightning (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Master of Nature
features.description: Bonus action: command creatures charmed by your Channel Divinity on their next turns.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: fog cloud, thunderwave (1st); gust of wind, shatter (3rd); call lightning, sleet storm (5th); control water, ice storm (7th); destructive wave, insect plague (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet hits you: Dex save, 2d8 lightning or thunder, half on a success. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.description: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, deal the maximum instead.

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.description: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, push it up to 10 feet.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 thunder (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: Flying speed equal to walking speed when not underground or indoors.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: Action, 2 ki: cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence without material components. You know minor illusion.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: teleport up to 60 feet to another dim or dark space, then advantage on your first melee attack this turn.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: In dim light or darkness, action: invisible until you attack, cast a spell or enter bright light.

features.name: Opportunist
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet is hit by someone else's attack: make a melee attack against it.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.description: Know Elemental Attunement plus one discipline (one more at 6th, 11th and 17th, swapping one each time). Spells from disciplines need no material components; from 5th level spend extra ki to upcast (max ki per spell 3 at 5th, 4 at 9th, 5 at 13th, 6 at 17th). Disciplines: Elemental Attunement (minor elemental tricks within 30 feet); Fangs of the Fire Snake (1 ki: +10 feet unarmed reach dealing fire, +1 ki for +1d10 fire); Fist of Four Thunders (2 ki: thunderwave); Fist of Unbroken Air (2 ki: Str save, 3d10 bludgeoning +1d10 per extra ki, push 20 feet and prone; half only on success); Rush of the Gale Spirits (2 ki: gust of wind); Shape the Flowing River (1 ki: reshape ice and water in a 30-foot area); Sweeping Cinder Strike (2 ki: burning hands); Water Whip (2 ki: Dex save, 3d10 bludgeoning +1d10 per extra ki, prone or pull 25 feet; half only on success); at 6th Clench of the North Wind (3 ki: hold person) and Gong of the Summit (3 ki: shatter); at 11th Flames of the Phoenix (4 ki: fireball), Mist Stance (4 ki: gaseous form on yourself) and Ride the Wind (4 ki: fly on yourself); at 17th Breath of Winter (6 ki: cone of cold), Eternal Mountain Defense (5 ki: stoneskin on yourself), River of Hungry Flame (5 ki: wall of fire) and Wave of Rolling Earth (6 ki: wall of stone).

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Once per turn after you cast a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell, the DM can have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the d100 Wild Magic Surge table (spells it produces ignore Metamagic and concentration).

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Advantage on one attack, check or save; regained after a long rest, or when the DM has you roll on the surge table after a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Reaction, 2 sorcery points: add or subtract 1d4 to another visible creature's attack, check or save after the roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: Roll twice on the surge table and choose.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.description: Once per turn, when a spell damage die rolls its maximum, roll one such die again and add it.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: faerie fire, sleep (1st); calm emotions, phantasmal force (2nd); blink, plant growth (3rd); dominate beast, greater invisibility (4th); dominate person, seeming (5th).

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: Action: creatures in a 10-foot cube from you make a Wis save or are charmed or frightened (your choice) until the end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Reaction when you take damage: invisible and teleport up to 60 feet, until your next turn or until you attack or cast. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: Immune to charm; reaction when a creature tries to charm you: it makes a Wis save or is charmed by you for 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.description: Action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save or is charmed or frightened for 1 minute (concentration, ends if damaged), lost in an illusory realm seeing only you. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: dissonant whispers, Tasha's hideous laughter (1st); detect thoughts, phantasmal force (2nd); clairvoyance, sending (3rd); dominate beast, Evard's black tentacles (4th); dominate person, telekinesis (5th).

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: Speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet that understands a language.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: Reaction when attacked: impose disadvantage; if it misses, your next attack against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it; resistance to psychic, and a creature that deals you psychic damage takes the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: Action: touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it until remove curse, the condition is removed, or you use this again; telepathy with it on the same plane.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Copying abjuration spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: When you cast a 1st-level or higher abjuration spell, create a ward (HP 2 x wizard level + Int, once per long rest) that takes damage for you; each later 1st-level or higher abjuration spell restores 2 x spell level HP to it.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet takes damage: your ward absorbs it.

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.description: Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of abjuration spells (counterspell, dispel magic).

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: Advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.description: Copying conjuration spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.description: Action: conjure a nonmagical object you've seen (up to 3 feet per side and 10 pounds) within 10 feet, glowing dimly; it lasts 1 hour or until it deals or takes damage.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.description: Action: teleport 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature. Once per long rest, or after you cast a 1st-level or higher conjuration spell.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.description: Damage can't break your concentration on conjuration spells.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.description: Creatures you summon or create with conjuration spells have 30 temporary HP.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Copying divination spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Portent
features.description: After a long rest roll two d20s; before a roll by you or a creature you can see, replace it with one of them (once per turn). Unused ones are lost at the next long rest.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: When you cast a 2nd-level or higher divination spell with a slot, regain a slot of a lower level (max 5th).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: Action, until incapacitated or a rest: darkvision 60 feet, see into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet, read any language, or see invisible things within 10 feet. Once per rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: Portent rolls three d20s.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.description: Copying enchantment spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.description: Action, a creature within 5 feet that sees or hears you makes a Wis save or is charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated until the end of your next turn; extend it with your action each turn. Ends if you move away, it loses sight and sound of you, or it takes damage. Once per long rest per creature.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you and another creature is in range: Wis save or it attacks the creature closest to it instead (a success makes it immune until a long rest).

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.description: A 1st-level or higher enchantment spell that targets one creature can target a second.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.description: A creature you charm with an enchantment can be left unaware of it; once before the spell ends, action: Int save or it forgets up to 1 + Cha mod hours of the charmed time.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Copying illusion spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.description: Learn minor illusion (or another wizard cantrip if you know it), not counted; it can make a sound and an image at once.

features.name: Malleable Illusions
features.description: Action: change an illusion of 1 minute or longer that you can see, within its normal parameters.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: Reaction when attacked: the attack automatically misses. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: Bonus action while a 1st-level or higher illusion spell lasts: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute (it can't directly harm anyone).

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.description: Copying necromancy spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.description: Once per turn, when your 1st-level or higher spell kills creatures (not constructs or undead), regain 2 x spell level HP (3 x for necromancy).

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.description: Add animate dead to your book; it targets one extra corpse, and your undead gain HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.description: Resistance to necrotic, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

features.name: Command Undead
features.description: Action, an undead within 60 feet makes a Cha save or obeys you until you use this again (Int 8+ has advantage; Int 12+ repeats the save each hour). A success makes it immune.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.description: Copying transmutation spells costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.description: Transform wood, stone (not gems), iron, copper or silver into another of those, 1 cubic foot per 10 minutes, for 1 hour or until your concentration ends.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.description: 8 hours to make a stone granting its holder one of: darkvision 60 feet, +10 feet speed while unencumbered, Con save proficiency, or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Change it when you cast a 1st-level or higher transmutation spell; a new stone ends the old.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: Add polymorph to your book; cast it on yourself without a slot into a beast of CR 1 or lower, once per short or long rest.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.description: Action, destroy your stone (remake after a long rest) for one: transmute a nonmagical object up to a 5-foot cube into one of equal or lesser value (10 minutes); remove curses, diseases and poisons and restore all HP to a creature you touch; raise dead without a slot; or reduce a willing creature's apparent age by 3d10 years (minimum 13).

features.name: Battlerager Armor
features.description: Dwarves only (DM may lift). Spiked armor (medium, AC 14 + Dex max 2, 75 gp) is a weapon for you: while raging, a bonus-action spike attack for 1d4 + Str piercing, and a successful grapple from the Attack action deals 3 piercing.

features.name: Reckless Abandon
features.description: Reckless Attack while raging gives temporary HP equal to your Con mod (min 1), lost when the rage ends.

features.name: Battlerager Charge
features.description: Dash as a bonus action while raging.

features.name: Spiked Retribution
features.description: While raging in spiked armor and not incapacitated, a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 3 piercing.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.description: When you use Second Wind, up to three allies within 60 feet who see or hear you regain HP equal to your fighter level.

features.name: Royal Envoy
features.description: Persuasion proficiency (or one of Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Performance) and double proficiency on Persuasion.

features.name: Inspiring Surge
features.description: When you Action Surge, an ally within 60 feet who sees or hears you can use its reaction for one weapon attack (two allies at 18th).

features.name: Bulwark
features.description: When you use Indomitable on an Int, Wis or Cha save, an ally within 60 feet who failed against the same effect and sees or hears you also rerolls.

features.name: Touch of Death
features.description: When you reduce a creature within 5 feet to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to Wis mod + monk level (min 1).

features.name: Hour of Reaping
features.description: Action: creatures within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Mastery of Death
features.description: When reduced to 0 HP, spend 1 ki to drop to 1 instead.

features.name: Touch of the Long Death
features.description: Action, spend 1 to 10 ki: a creature within 5 feet makes a Con save, 2d10 necrotic per ki, half on a success.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Always prepared: command, compelled duel (3rd); warding bond, zone of truth (5th); aura of vitality, spirit guardians (9th); banishment, guardian of faith (13th); circle of power, geas (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Champion Challenge: bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or can't willingly move more than 30 feet from you. Turn the Tide: bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet at half HP or less regain 1d6 + Cha mod (min 1).

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet takes damage: you take it instead; it can't be reduced.

features.name: Unyielding Spirit
features.description: Advantage on saves against paralyzed and stunned.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.description: Action, 1 hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage; allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saves, and you and they have advantage on Wis saves. Once per long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: false life, ray of sickness (1st); blindness/deafness, silence (2nd); feign death, speak with dead (3rd); aura of life, death ward (4th); contagion, legend lore (5th).

features.name: Among the Dead
features.description: Learn spare the dying; advantage on saves against disease. An undead that targets you directly makes a Wis save or must pick another target (a success, or your attacking it, makes it immune for 24 hours).

features.name: Defy Death
features.description: When you succeed on a death save or stabilize a creature with spare the dying, regain 1d8 + Con mod HP. Once per long rest.

features.name: Undying Nature
features.description: Hold your breath indefinitely; no need for food, water or sleep; age one year per ten and immune to magical aging.

features.name: Indestructible Life
features.description: Bonus action: regain 1d8 + warlock level HP and reattach a severed part you hold in place. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: false life, ray of sickness (1st); blindness/deafness, ray of enfeeblement (3rd); animate dead, vampiric touch (5th); blight, death ward (7th); antilife shell, cloudkill (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Martial weapons.

features.name: Reaper
features.description: Learn one necromancy cantrip from any list. A necromancy cantrip that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
features.description: When you hit with a melee attack, spend Channel Divinity for extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction
features.description: Necrotic damage from your cleric spells and Channel Divinity ignores necrotic resistance.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 necrotic (2d8 at 14th).

features.name: Improved Reaper
features.description: A 1st to 5th level necromancy spell that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other (consumed components needed for each).

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Replaces prior oath spells: hellish rebuke, inflict wounds (3rd); crown of madness, darkness (5th); animate dead, bestow curse (9th); blight, confusion (13th); contagion, dominate person (17th). Requires evil alignment.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Control Undead: action, an undead within 30 feet makes a Wis save or obeys you for 24 hours (no effect if its CR is at least your level). Dreadful Aspect: action, chosen creatures within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save if they end a turn more than 30 feet away.

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.description: You and fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Cha mod (min +1) to melee weapon damage; 30 feet at 18th. One paladin's aura per creature.

features.name: Supernatural Resistance
features.description: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

features.name: Dread Lord
features.description: Action, 1 minute, once per long rest: bright light within 30 feet becomes dim; enemies frightened of you that start a turn in it take 4d10 psychic; attacks relying on sight have disadvantage against you and chosen allies in it; bonus action for a melee spell attack dealing 3d10 + Cha mod necrotic.

features.name: Giant's Power
features.description: Learn Giant (or another language if you know it) and druidcraft or thaumaturgy (Wis).

features.name: Giant's Havoc
features.description: While raging: add Rage Damage to Strength-based thrown weapon hits, reach +5 feet, and become Large if smaller and space allows.

features.name: Elemental Cleaver
features.description: On entering rage, infuse a held weapon with acid, cold, fire, thunder or lightning: damage becomes that type, +1d6 of it, and it gains thrown (20/60) and returns after a throw. Bonus action to swap the type.

features.name: Mighty Impel
features.description: Bonus action while raging: move a Medium or smaller creature in reach to a space within 30 feet; unwilling targets make a Str save (DC 8 + PB + Str). Unsupported targets fall prone.

features.name: Demiurgic Colossus
features.description: Raging reach +10 feet and you can become Large or Huge; Mighty Impel works on Large or smaller; Elemental Cleaver extra damage becomes 2d6.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: bane, false life (1st); blindness/deafness, phantasmal force (2nd); phantom steed, speak with dead (3rd); death ward, greater invisibility (4th); antilife shell, cloudkill (5th).

features.name: Form of Dread
features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, PB times per long rest: gain 1d10 + warlock level temp HP, immunity to frightened, and once per turn a hit can force a Wis save or the target is frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.description: No need to eat, drink or breathe. Once per turn change an attack's damage to necrotic; in Form of Dread roll one extra damage die.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.description: Necrotic resistance (immunity in Form of Dread). Reaction when reduced to 0 HP: drop to 1 instead, chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d10 + warlock level necrotic, and you gain a level of exhaustion. Recharges after 1d4 long rests.

features.name: Spirit Projection
features.description: Action, once per long rest, up to 1 hour (concentration): project your spirit, leaving your body unconscious. Gain BPS resistance, no V, S or costless M components for conjuration and necromancy, fly speed equal to walking (hover, move through objects), and in Form of Dread heal half the necrotic damage you deal once per turn.

features.name: Draconic Disciple
features.description: Draconic Presence: reaction to reroll a failed Intimidation or Persuasion check (once per long rest if it succeeds). Draconic Strike: unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison. Tongue of Dragons: learn Draconic or another language.

features.name: Breath of the Dragon
features.description: Replace one attack of the Attack action with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line: Dex save vs ki DC, two Martial Arts dice of a chosen element, half on success (three dice at 11th). PB uses per long rest, then 2 ki each.

features.name: Wings Unfurled
features.description: When you use Step of the Wind, gain a fly speed equal to walking speed until the end of your turn. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
features.description: Bonus action, 10-foot aura for 1 minute: Frightful Presence (bonus action, Wis save or frightened, repeating) or Resistance to a chosen element for you and allies in it. Once per long rest or 3 ki.

features.name: Ascendant Aspect
features.description: Augment Breath: 1 ki for a 60-foot cone or 90-foot line dealing four dice. Blindsight 10 feet. Explosive Fury: activating Aspect of the Wyrm forces chosen creatures in the aura to make a Dex save or take 3d10 of a chosen element.

features.name: Draconic Gift
features.description: Learn thaumaturgy (ranger spell) and Draconic or another language.

features.name: Drake Companion
features.description: Action: summon your Small dragon drake within 30 feet (AC 14 + PB, HP 5 + 5 x ranger level, speed 40, bite +3 + PB for 1d6 + PB piercing, reaction Infused Strikes adds 1d6 of its essence to an ally's weapon hit within 30 feet). Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison essence for its immunity. Acts on your turn; Dodges unless you spend a bonus action to command it. Once per long rest or a 1st-level slot.

features.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
features.description: Drake gains wings (fly speed equal to walking), grows to Medium and can be ridden (no flying while ridden), bite adds 1d6 of its essence, and you gain resistance to its essence type.

features.name: Drake's Breath
features.description: Action: you or the drake exhale a 30-foot cone of a chosen element, Dex save vs spell DC, 8d6 (10d6 at 15th), half on success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

features.name: Perfected Bond
features.description: Bite adds another 1d6 (2d6 total); drake grows to Large and can fly while ridden; reaction PB times per long rest to give you or the drake resistance to one instance of damage while within 30 feet.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.description: Bonus action: create an echo of yourself within 15 feet (AC 14 + PB, 1 HP, immune to conditions, uses your saves); it moves 30 feet on your turn for free and is destroyed beyond 30 feet. Bonus action and 15 feet of movement to swap places; Attack action attacks can originate from it; reaction opportunity attacks from its space.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.description: When you take the Attack action, make one extra melee attack from the echo. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.description: Action: see and hear through the echo for up to 10 minutes (you are blinded and deafened); it can be up to 1,000 feet away.

features.name: Shadow Martyr
features.description: Reaction before an attack roll against a creature you see: teleport the echo within 5 feet of it and the attack targets the echo. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.description: When your echo is destroyed by damage, gain 2d6 + Con mod temp HP if you have none. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Legion of One
features.description: Manifest two coexisting echoes; and when you roll initiative with no Unleash Incarnation uses, regain one.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.description: Reaction after you or a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: force a reroll (after seeing the result). Twice per long rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.description: Add your Int mod to initiative.

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.description: Action: a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet makes a Con save or is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.description: When you cast a spell of 4th level or lower, store it in a bead for 1 hour (AC 15, 1 HP); a holder can release it as an action using your attack bonus and DC. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Convergent Future
features.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: set the roll to the minimum needed to succeed or one less. Gain a level of exhaustion, removable only by a long rest.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute: halve or double the weight of a Large or smaller creature or object within 30 feet (Huge at 10th). Halved: +10 speed, double jump, disadvantage on Str checks and saves. Doubled: -10 speed, advantage on Str checks and saves.

features.name: Gravity Well
features.description: When a spell you cast hits a creature with an attack, it fails a save, or it is willing, move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space.

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.description: Reaction: a weapon hit by a creature within 60 feet deals an extra 1d10, or a fall within 60 feet deals an extra 2d10. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Event Horizon
features.description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute: hostile creatures starting a turn within 30 feet make a Str save, taking 2d10 force and speed 0 on a failure, or half damage and 2 extra feet per foot moved on a success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

features.name: Lunar Embodiment
features.description: Learn the Lunar Spells (not counted against spells known): shield, ray of sickness, color spray (1st); lesser restoration, blindness/deafness, alter self (3rd); dispel magic, vampiric touch, phantom steed (5th); death ward, confusion, hallucinatory terrain (7th); Rary's telepathic bond, hold monster, mislead (9th). After a long rest pick Full, New or Crescent Moon; cast that phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest.

features.name: Moon Fire
features.description: Learn sacred flame (not counted against cantrips); it can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

features.name: Lunar Boons
features.description: Metamagic on spells of your phase's schools costs 1 less sorcery point (Full: abjuration, divination; New: enchantment, necromancy; Crescent: illusion, transmutation). PB times per long rest.

features.name: Waxing and Waning
features.description: Bonus action and 1 sorcery point to change phase. You can cast each phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest while in that phase.

features.name: Lunar Empowerment
features.description: Full: bonus action to shed 10-foot bright light, advantage on Investigation and Perception for you and chosen creatures in it. New: advantage on Stealth, and attacks against you have disadvantage while you are in darkness. Crescent: resistance to necrotic and radiant.

features.name: Lunar Phenomenon
features.description: Bonus action (or as part of changing phase), once per long rest each or 5 sorcery points. Full: chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save or are blinded until the end of their next turn, and one creature regains 3d8 HP. New: Dex save or 3d10 necrotic and speed 0, and you turn invisible until the end of your next turn. Crescent: teleport 60 feet with one willing creature, both gaining resistance to all damage until your next turn.

features.name: Martial Maneuvers
features.description: Learn three Carrion Raven maneuvers (one more at 6th, 10th, and 14th; swap one each time). Maneuver points equal twice your Barbarian level, regained on a long rest; one maneuver per turn; save DC 8 + PB + Con mod. Apex Dominance (5, action): Str save (Disadvantage if you grapple it) or 6d10 force, half on success; kills outright at 0 HP. Axolotl's Regeneration (2 or 6, bonus action): heal 1d12 + Con mod; at 6 points also regrow a limb or organ. Bestial Transformation (8, action): polymorph yourself into a beast of CR up to half your level, keeping mental scores. Call of the Beast Lord (5, action, concentration): summon a beast of CR up to your level for 10 minutes. Carrion Feast (4, action): melee attack with +5d6 necrotic and temp HP equal to it. Falcon's Glide (1, reaction): slow a fall to 60 feet per round, and 1 more point per bonus action for 30-foot flight that turn. Feral Fighting (1, bonus action): an unarmed strike dealing 1d8. Hibernating Bear Recuperation (5, action): a 10-minute sleep with resistance to non-psychic damage that counts as a short rest, ends poison, removes 1 exhaustion, and turns spent Hit Dice into temp HP. Pack Leader (1, reaction): when an adjacent enemy is attacked, give that attack advantage and attack it yourself. Predator's Howl (2, bonus action): two creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened until your next turn, taking +1d6 psychic from weapon hits. Shape of the Behemoth (3, action, concentration, 1 minute): grow a size (max Large), +5 feet reach, +1d6 weapon damage, 1d6 temp HP each turn. Slippery Otter (1, bonus action): swim 30, hold breath for twice your Con score in minutes, bonus action Dash in water for an hour. Snout of the Bloodhound (1, 1 minute): for an hour, advantage on Perception and tracking, add PB to initiative, no disadvantage against invisible creatures. Stoic Oxen Spirit (2, reaction): end charmed or frightened and gain advantage against its source until the end of your next turn. Trampling Bull (3, bonus action): move your speed through creatures your size or smaller; each makes a Str save or falls prone and takes 1d8 + Str mod bludgeoning. Tusks of the Rampaging Mammoth (3, action): a melee attack dealing +3d12 and pushing a Huge or smaller target 15 feet. Woolly Beast's Hide (2+, reaction): reduce a hit's damage by 1d6 per 2 points and gain that much temp HP.

features.name: Feral Celerity
features.description: Make one weapon attack as part of the bonus action that starts your rage, and you can concentrate on maneuvers (not spells) while raging.

features.name: Raven's Spirit
features.description: Proficiency in Animal Handling (or Athletics, Nature, or Survival if you have it), and you can cast speak with animals as a ritual.

features.name: Ferocious Rage
features.description: When you rage, chosen creatures within 10 feet that can see you make a Wisdom save against your maneuver DC or are frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Violent Hunger
features.description: Once per attack, when a weapon damage die rolls its maximum, spend 1 maneuver point to roll another of that die and add it.

features.name: Martial Maneuvers
features.description: Learn three Blade Breaker maneuvers (more at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th; swap one each time). Maneuver points equal twice your fighter level, regained on a long rest; one maneuver per turn; save DC 8 + PB + Str or Dex mod. Arcing Iron (1+, bonus action): your next melee attack also hits each other creature in reach, 1 point per extra target. Armor-Crushing Blows (4): a hit deals no damage but a Dex or Con save or nonmagical armor loses 2 AC (destroyed if already damaged). Blade Breaking Blow (4): the same against a nonmagical weapon (half damage, then destroyed). Blade of Eternal Demise (3, action): for 8 hours your weapon's damage to a named creature also lowers its HP maximum until a long rest, and it can't be revived while the weapon touches it. Commanding Grasp (2, action): a creature your size or smaller within 30 feet makes a Str save or is teleported next to you and grappled. Contest of Wills (1, bonus action): opposed Intimidation; the winner has advantage on attacks against the other until the end of its next turn. Disarming Swipe (2): a hit deals no damage but a Str or Dex save or it drops its weapons and shield. Helmsplitter (4): on a hit, Con save or stunned until the end of its next turn (disadvantage if you had advantage). Iron Tempest (4, action): your hits this turn deal +2d6 and you make PB extra attacks, each at a different target. Refusal to Bleed (1, reaction): reduce damage by 1d10 + fighter level; 3 more points extends it to that attacker until your next turn. Steely Determination (1): Second Wind heals an extra fighter level. Unstoppable Missile (2, action): throw your melee weapon in a 30-foot line; Dex save or weapon damage + Str or Dex mod, 1 point more per creature for +2d6. Wall of Blades (2, reaction): when hit, attack the attacker and use the attack roll as your AC until your next turn.

features.name: Stance of the Blade Breaker
features.description: Learn a stance (more at 7th, 10th, and 15th); enter one on initiative and switch as a bonus action.
